resolved_source_locations.conclusion: [topsep=2pt,itemsep=1pt] P1: admissible only when the candidate cluster carries a selected update, a quotient or relation record, and a witness of descent compatibility, descent obstruction, or update-vs-quotient mismatch. Generic semantics, generic predicate meaning, generic selection criteria, and generic agency are not admissible as P1 projections in the absence of such a witness. P2: admissible only when the candidate carries a macro specification, a realization relation, specification-satisfaction data, and evidence of representability or non-representability. Macro-level predicates or objectives count only insofar as they are treated as content to be represented. Mere quotient equality, arbitrary relations without representability structure, and empirical observations without level and threshold data are not admissible as P2 projections. P3: admissible only when the candidate carries enriched route grammar, generated same-source, same-target route terms, and route-comparison data with a non-reducibility or coherence-mismatch certificate. Generic transitions, generic causal arrows, generic path records, and route undefinedness arising from P1 obstruction are not admissible as P3 projections unless the route/coherence threshold is explicitly present and the route comparison is specifically of the P3 type. P4: admissible only when the candidate carries a stage, order, transition, refinement, staged-dynamics, or regime-ordering record with laws beyond bare labels. Bare labels, arbitrary relations without order, transition, or refinement law, quotient packaging, and audit bookkeeping are not admissible as P4 projections. P5: admissible only when the candidate carries a quotient relation, a packaging map, the identification of distinct micro-elements, a same-package or quotient-object record, and quotient-validity evidence. Generic structural paths, derivations, topologies or geometries merely because they have paths, and causal chains are not admissible as P5 projections unless quotient or packaging data is present. P6: admissible only when the candidate carries an audit record with event reference, provenance or dependency trace, replay or check structure, and bookkeeping or checkability structure. Passive logs alone, arbitrary metadata, and certificate-only content without audit/provenance/replay/check structure are not admissible as P6 projections. Tracked in the formalization harness as a conditional schema (SixBirds.alignment_rules); see Appendix .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We present a math-only framework in which theories arise as fixed points of idempotent operators and open-endedness requires changing the operator rather than iterating it. Under minimal hypotheses of composability plus limited interface access with bounded observation, we show that the operator vocabulary P1–P6 arises canonically as unavoidable closure mechanics (Theorem ). Order-theoretic closure operators and dynamics-induced endomaps E_ ,f (built from a Markov kernel, a coarse-graining lens, and a timescale) are treated uniformly via the abstraction of idempotent endomaps and their fixed points. We define a computable total-variation idempotence defect for E_ ,f and show that small retention error implies approximate idempotence, yielding robust packaged “objects” at a given time-scale within a fixed lens/theory. To prevent spurious directionality, we define arrow-of-time as path-space KL divergence and prove that coarse-graining cannot increase it (data processing); we further formalize the protocol-trap principle showing that autonomous protocol holonomy does not generate sustained asymmetry unless a genuine affinity is present in the lifted dynamics. Finally, we give a finite forcing-style counting lemma: definable predicates are exponentially rare relative to a partition-based theory, so generic predicate extensions are overwhelmingly non-definable, providing a mathematically clean anti-saturation mechanism for strict ladder climbing.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Scoped event admissibility on fixed support leaves a specific gap for strict tests: the protocol-indexed flagship-seed bridge family realizes the quadratic-levelset and transition-stability slots, but the protocol-indexed readout-agreement slot remains unrealized, so no accepted strict test family is available at the bridge-native event level. This paper asks whether strict-test acceptance is admissible on fixed support without repairing that bridge level. The method is a layer-local, audit-based PICA route: promotion, internalization of protocol coordinates, carrier exactification, and audited source admission produce a carrier substrate above the bridge-native level. On the resulting carriers, the readout-agreement, quadratic-witness, and transition-witness slots are strict-realized natively; the three-slot strict domain closes; and accepted scoped strict test families survive the required control panel. The panel covers null-baseline, memory-only, artifact, boundary, selected-lift, visibility, and claim-boundary checks. The bridge-native level is retained as the : descent from new-layer evidence to old-layer compatibility preserves non-factorization without inducing old-layer strict realization. The final classification is a strict theory extension at the new layer with old-layer real-provisional compatibility intact. The result is bounded: it does not assert event-package construction, shared-event identity, proto-effect or effect-algebra structure, Born valuation, composition readiness, faithful public compression, a lawful public carrier, or canonical selected lifts.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: [Recognition hypothesis] A description D ∈ FATCD satisfies the recognition hypothesis when every residual feature r ∈ Residual D is recognized: the closure content of r either supplies the witness type of one of the six role meanings of Definition — so that r , or a finite composite of its constituents, projects to P1, , P6 under Proposition — or instantiates one of the six annotation kinds of Definition , or is substrate already accounted for by the audit discipline of FATCD. Equivalently, D carries no finite audited residual feature whose closure content is irreducible to the six role meanings, and in particular none whose role-theoretic content emerges only in an assembled cluster and is not the join of its constituents' role labels. [The recognition hypothesis is assumed, not derived] The recognition hypothesis is an explicit assumption on D , not a consequence of the FATCD definitions. Two kinds of finite, audited, in-domain feature are not known to be recognized: a feature carrying a conservation or balance law over declared records — a finite resource invariant of the kind admitted by Definition — whose content supplies none of the six witness types, and a feature whose closure content is an emergent obstruction or holonomy of an assembled cluster, not reducible to the role labels of its constituents. Whether every finite audited feature is recognized — equivalently, whether the six roles are recognition-complete for FATCD — is left open and is recorded with the endogenous-instrument meta-limit of Sections and . The three threat closures of Propositions – establish the recognition hypothesis unconditionally for the three highest-priority threat classes; the classification theorem below assumes it in general.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The prior carrier-exactification result is deliberately scoped: it is a carrier-exactification statement on the fixed Route A flagship support, not a public event package and not a public carrier theorem. Its lawful object is a refined same-branch witness; its public-side object is a coarse signature shadow. The relationship between the two is non-faithful: public signatures retain operational readout information but do not determine the refined law-bearing carrier data. In standard ontic/epistemic language , the public shadow is an epistemic image of the carrier; in Markov-chain language , the carrier-to-public map is lumpable only in a restricted sense. Throughout this paper we refer to these objects descriptively — the refined witness (lawful, carrier-side), the public signature shadow (coarse, readout-side), and the witness-to-shadow basis that relates them without supplying a faithful inverse. The corresponding machine-readable identifiers are listed once, in Appendix . Consequently the public shadow can supply public/readout-side predicates for later bridge records, but it cannot by itself supply lawful carrier structure or shared-event identity.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Six Birds Foundations I introduced a stratified closure calculus with six primitive closure roles. The present paper extends that calculus into a theorem-level framework in three parts: a primitive role architecture fixing the meanings, levels, local boundaries, and selected lifts of the six typed closure roles P_1, ,P_6 ; an admissibility and meta-theory regime in which honest bookkeeping, typed non-collapse, level profiles, forgetting with selected lifts, activation thresholds, instrument-relative visibility, and empirical-bridge admissibility are stated as theorem schemas; and a scoped exact-six theorem chain over the domain of finite audited typed closure descriptions. Within this domain we prove six role-lower-bound witnesses, an upper-bound classification with corrected role-projection alignments (closing the probability, causality, and agency threats in the covered scope), a decomposition/exhaustion theorem, and an integrated stress certification. The terminal theorem asserts that every D admits a well-formed decomposition/exhaustion record with exactly six role channels, each in one of five recorded statuses, with residual features classified under an explicit scheme and, under an explicit recognition hypothesis (the three principal threat classes — probability, causality, and agency — closed unconditionally), no seventh irreducible role required in the covered scope. The claim concerns role channels rather than active projections, and the decomposition is existential, not unique. We do not claim unrestricted exact-six, all-emergence coverage, a full six-primitives algebra, global primitive independence, empirical realization, internal instrument-family completeness, or recognition-completeness of the six roles.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Formal incompleteness explains why no sufficiently expressive effective theory captures all arithmetic truth, but it does not by itself provide a structural language for comparing theory growth. This paper develops such a language by treating a formal theory as a packaged closure object evaluated on a frozen ledger. First, a fixed idempotent package saturates under iteration: repeated closure does not sustain persistent strict growth. Hence genuine growth requires package change. Second, on a frozen slice with fixed yield, cost, and support data, efficiency transfers across cone-equivalent representatives, yielding a restricted alignment theorem. Third, these internal results combine with an explicit external dependency contract to give a conditional arithmetic lift: if the required canonical-family-on-cone assumptions are discharged from the arithmetic literature, then frontier-efficient extension operators admit canonical representatives on the relevant comparison cone. The result reframes incompleteness and axiom choice in package language. G\"odel becomes the canonical fixed-package failure mode, while new axioms appear as controlled package changes evaluated under a frozen regime. Vendor-backed PICA evidence is used only to discipline primitive roles and scope, not as proof support.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Given two probe families on the same finite-dimensional carrier, this paper asks what a dissolving family D measures beyond what a native family L can explain under an audit energy C . Under the standing legal-energy quotient and null-mode legality hypotheses, the adequacy residual _C(D L) is the Schur-complement leftover built from the block currencies K_ LL , K_ DD , K_ DL , and K_ LD . We develop this residual as a calculus: the projection identity identifies it with T_D(I-P_L)T_D^* in energy-scaled coordinates; optimality and exact adequacy characterize Loewner minimality and zero residual; promotion combines native and residual budgets into a dissolving budget; and chain-rule, data-processing, and transfer laws describe native extension, post-processing, coarsening, and exact or defective bridges. The blind-spot witness theorem turns failure of a declared residual budget into an explicit recombination vector with positive excess. The paper does not claim exact adequacy generically, does not classify all probe-family pairs, and does not claim novelty for the classical operator-theoretic constructions it packages. A layer-dissolving use of the calculus is given in .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Formal incompleteness explains why no sufficiently expressive effective theory captures all arithmetic truth, but it does not by itself provide a structural language for comparing theory growth. This paper develops such a language by treating a formal theory as a packaged closure object evaluated on a frozen ledger. First, a fixed idempotent package saturates under iteration: repeated closure does not sustain persistent strict growth. Hence genuine growth requires package change. Second, on a frozen slice with fixed yield, cost, and support data, efficiency transfers across cone-equivalent representatives, yielding a restricted alignment theorem. Third, these internal results combine with an explicit external dependency contract to give a conditional arithmetic lift: if the required canonical-family-on-cone assumptions are discharged from the arithmetic literature, then frontier-efficient extension operators admit canonical representatives on the relevant comparison cone. The result reframes incompleteness and axiom choice in package language. G\"odel becomes the canonical fixed-package failure mode, while new axioms appear as controlled package changes evaluated under a frozen regime. Vendor-backed PICA evidence is used only to discipline primitive roles and scope, not as proof support.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Given two probe families on the same finite-dimensional carrier, this paper asks what a dissolving family D measures beyond what a native family L can explain under an audit energy C . Under the standing legal-energy quotient and null-mode legality hypotheses, the adequacy residual _C(D L) is the Schur-complement leftover built from the block currencies K_ LL , K_ DD , K_ DL , and K_ LD . We develop this residual as a calculus: the projection identity identifies it with T_D(I-P_L)T_D^* in energy-scaled coordinates; optimality and exact adequacy characterize Loewner minimality and zero residual; promotion combines native and residual budgets into a dissolving budget; and chain-rule, data-processing, and transfer laws describe native extension, post-processing, coarsening, and exact or defective bridges. The blind-spot witness theorem turns failure of a declared residual budget into an explicit recombination vector with positive excess. The paper does not claim exact adequacy generically, does not classify all probe-family pairs, and does not claim novelty for the classical operator-theoretic constructions it packages. A layer-dissolving use of the calculus is given in .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Next-token prediction is not, by itself, a theory of compositional content: finite predictive statistics can agree while the induced quotients compose differently under larger contexts. We study an alternative, non-gradient formulation in which a language model is an audited ledger of finite theory extensions rather than a parameter vector. Six Birds Theory (SBT) supplies the admissibility calculus: typed closure-package layers, explicit quotient maps, audit records, nonclaim records, and promotion gates based on descent, stability, control, no-smuggling, legibility, and strict factorization failure. We introduce Language Theory Models (LTMs), a prototype architecture for structural recovery on fixed sequence corpora. An LTM accumulates typed transition evidence, monitors each active layer with a conditional-information closure-deficit statistic and an idempotence/self-consistency defect, and proposes new layers only when the current quotient leaves recoverable structure unresolved. Candidate layers are committed only after an explicit gate panel emits a strict-extension certificate; otherwise the runtime records a typed defect or remains silent rather than laundering fallback evidence into a stronger claim. We report a code-backed feasibility study on Shakespeare: the runtime builds closure-package layers, records promotion attempts and failures, emits halt verdicts, caps unaudited fallback readout, and demonstrates strict R-layer growth in bounded runs. Independent of the LTM runtime, we provide a structural probe suite that tests SBT framework-level commitments under blue-team and red-team cases, including growth, forgetting, uncertainty, auditability, and concept-separation scenarios. The contribution is a concrete audited substrate for testing whether compositional structure in a fixed corpus can be recovered as a finite ladder of certified theory refinements.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The structural laws of the Six Birds corpus through Foundations IV are stated from the standpoint of an external theorist: the theorist declares a lens, detects an obstruction, installs a repair, prices a residual, and runs the audit. This paper makes the closure apparatus part of the carrier. An endogenous closure system carries its own instruments, ledgers, repair generator, boundary records, and re-audit loop, and its claims of self-repair are admitted only when the relevant records are produced by its own transitions under a closed-loop source policy. Six definitions (D1–D6) and sixteen laws (E1–E16) give the resulting catalog: endogenous repair, bounded reflexivity, self-maintenance, repair compilation and collapse; priced exposure, alarm, control prices, and probe acquisition; stack rewrite, individuation, and repair transport; and reconsolidation, offline reclosure, and adaptability. The laws are carrier-side and substrate-independent. Living, cognitive, and social systems therefore enter on equal terms: physiological regulation and organismal maintenance, agent-side learning and control, and institutional reproduction and rewrite are distinct realizations of the same typed hypotheses, not metaphors for one another. Each law is stated in the six-part normal form inherited from Foundations IV, with an obstruction or falsifier, an exactly-one status partition where applicable, a proof spine, interaction discipline, and explicit nonclaims. D1–D6 and the core E1–E16 laws are represented in the companion Lean 4 development and finite Repair-World/law-specific campaign; two named interpretive corollaries, Alarm Fatigue and Operational Selfhood, remain unformalized and are marked accordingly. The finite campaign contains 348 preregistered comparisons across fifteen law-specific result artifacts, all passing. Existing particle and neural substrate experiments supply life-facing null, drive, maintenance, motif, and intervention evidence under explicit nonclaims, while an unrun planarian-regeneration protocol states a concrete biological promotion target and its falsifiers. No definition of biological life, consciousness, death, welfare, or autonomous evolution is claimed.

It is paired with the six primitive moves that change what theories can exist and what objects they recognize. resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: A standing question in foundations is whether the deep problems of distinct domains — why the Standard Model has the structure it does, and why quantum mechanics and general relativity fail to combine — share any common explanatory machinery. We report that one frozen, layer-agnostic structural calculus (the Six Birds emergence calculus) — a catalog of substrate-independent laws governing how one theory emerges as a quotient/closure of another — produces foundational-grade results on both, and yields three forced, falsifiable, mainstream-contradicting predictions. Applied under an anti-contamination guard on finite, audited, reproducible toy carriers, the calculus gives the two opposite result-genres its own laws anticipate. For the Standard Model, a demarcation separating the structurally forced from the irreducibly observed-input, recovering non-circularly the grand-unified embedding ratios ^2 _W = 3/8 and k_Y = 5/3 and unifying proton stability, monopole absence, and color separation as one object. For QM–GR, a unification that recognizes Ryu–Takayanagi holographic entanglement as a case of one ledger/shadow-price duality. The three predictions each contradict a prevailing program. (i) Boundary entanglement does not determine bulk geometry: the entanglement geometry map carries a robust kernel, so strong ``it-from-qubit'' fails. (ii) Gravity does not mediate entanglement: its channel is forced to be classically-indexed, so BMV-class experiments are predicted null, testable on tabletop timescales within the decade. (iii) Record-stability forbids proton decay and magnetic monopoles, against grand unification. One record/memory layer underlies all three. Every result is computed under adversarial self-correction against explicit can-fail controls, and two were externally reviewed and settled. We claim no frame-transfer: the results are conditional, toy-level structural facts ( n=2 on universality), offered as a proof of principle and placed before the community to test.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Earlier work in the Six-Bird program supplies six primitive role families ( P_1, ,P_6 — descent, representability, route mismatch, refinement, packaging, audit), an admissibility and exact-six scope discipline over FATCD , inherited status, threshold, visibility, and audit machinery, and concrete model fragments such as PICA and Cantor. It does not, however, supply a paper-level finite interaction calculus that records, in one finite typed framework, how the six primitive roles interact, how typed directed cells are judged, how defects induce statuses, how promotion is audited, and how model realizations are scoped. This paper constructs , a finite audited typed calculus for six-bird interaction. The calculus carries finite typed schemas of theory packages, instruments, visibility and suppression records, witness and update families, role-channel, directed-cell, pair-observable, promotion, dependency, and no-go judgments, defect records, statuses, gates, audit records, and model-realization maps. Every component is finite, admissibility is checked on finite records, and every claim is recorded under an explicit host or instrument together with a nonclaim register. The main theorem groups are: no total six-symbol algebra; typed non-collapse and status-family separation; finite well-formedness and covered-cell status uniqueness; descent, closure-deficit, completion, saturation, strict-extension, and definability results; graph and cohomology no-drive results; promotion-gate soundness; and no-overreading and finite rotating-audit theorems. The numbered stack comprises theorem-grade Theorems 1–28 and 30–32, model-grade Model Theorems 29, 33, and 34, and audit-grade Proposition 35. The repository includes a Lean 4 validation track, pinned to leanprover/lean4:v4.28.0, whose manifest-driven strict validator audits the paper-to-Lean declaration coverage. The mathematical content of these theorems is standard — descent through a finite quotient, idempotent saturation, the Kullback–Leibler decomposition, finite cycle/cochain duality, the universal property of the image factorization, and so on — and is not claimed as novel; what the paper contributes is the calculus, its scope discipline, the countermodel atlas, and the explicit nonclaim register within which these results are restated and used. Twelve countermodels CM_1 – CM_ 12 each block a specific overclaim, and four scoped model-realization statements cover finite stochastic PICA, audited Cantor shells, finite abstract-interpretation hosts, and finite graph and cohomology supports. Each model realization is host-bound, fragment-scoped, and certified at claim-strength model_realization rather than theorem-grade accepted. The paper does not prove a universal exact-six theorem, a universal six-symbol algebra, a unique decomposition theorem, an empirical realization claim, or complete same-level self-certification.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The paper records the promotion-and-stacking theorems of Section 10 and the self-reference theorems of Section 11: Promotion gate soundness (Theorem 19) and strict promotion implies nonfactorization (Theorem 20): any accepted-family promotion verdict requires every required core gate to exist and pass, and a strict promotion verdict implies a nonfactorization witness on the carrier. Non-strict promotion implies factorization (Theorem 21): a non-strict promotion verdict on an admissible bridge implies a factorization filler. Toy strict bridge (Example Theorem 22): a finite two-layer bridge witnesses the strict-promotion pattern without proving any general stacking-composition theorem. No-overreading suppression (Theorem 23, Section 11): no I -accepted claim depends on unbridged suppressed content. Same-level self-audit failure (Theorem 24, Section 11): an instrument I_ 0 does not certify its own complete soundness; the verdict is outside_scope or undefined_circular . Finite rotating-audit theorem (Theorem 25, Section 11): a finite stack I_ N admits a level- N+1 extension instrument that audits the lower stack and accepts compliance iff the stack-audit defect is empty, while remaining non-final on its own soundness.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Next-token prediction is not, by itself, a theory of compositional content: finite predictive statistics can agree while the induced quotients compose differently under larger contexts. We study an alternative, non-gradient formulation in which a language model is an audited ledger of finite theory extensions rather than a parameter vector. Six Birds Theory (SBT) supplies the admissibility calculus: typed closure-package layers, explicit quotient maps, audit records, nonclaim records, and promotion gates based on descent, stability, control, no-smuggling, legibility, and strict factorization failure. We introduce Language Theory Models (LTMs), a prototype architecture for structural recovery on fixed sequence corpora. An LTM accumulates typed transition evidence, monitors each active layer with a conditional-information closure-deficit statistic and an idempotence/self-consistency defect, and proposes new layers only when the current quotient leaves recoverable structure unresolved. Candidate layers are committed only after an explicit gate panel emits a strict-extension certificate; otherwise the runtime records a typed defect or remains silent rather than laundering fallback evidence into a stronger claim. We report a code-backed feasibility study on Shakespeare: the runtime builds closure-package layers, records promotion attempts and failures, emits halt verdicts, caps unaudited fallback readout, and demonstrates strict R-layer growth in bounded runs. Independent of the LTM runtime, we provide a structural probe suite that tests SBT framework-level commitments under blue-team and red-team cases, including growth, forgetting, uncertainty, auditability, and concept-separation scenarios. The contribution is a concrete audited substrate for testing whether compositional structure in a fixed corpus can be recovered as a finite ladder of certified theory refinements.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The previous subsections describe what the institutional state does. The last question is whether it is admissible as a promoted layer object, rather than a modeler's relabeling of the old stage vocabulary. resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The structural laws of the Six Birds corpus through Foundations IV are stated from the standpoint of an external theorist: the theorist declares a lens, detects an obstruction, installs a repair, prices a residual, and runs the audit. This paper makes the closure apparatus part of the carrier. An endogenous closure system carries its own instruments, ledgers, repair generator, boundary records, and re-audit loop, and its claims of self-repair are admitted only when the relevant records are produced by its own transitions under a closed-loop source policy. Six definitions (D1–D6) and sixteen laws (E1–E16) give the resulting catalog: endogenous repair, bounded reflexivity, self-maintenance, repair compilation and collapse; priced exposure, alarm, control prices, and probe acquisition; stack rewrite, individuation, and repair transport; and reconsolidation, offline reclosure, and adaptability. The laws are carrier-side and substrate-independent. Living, cognitive, and social systems therefore enter on equal terms: physiological regulation and organismal maintenance, agent-side learning and control, and institutional reproduction and rewrite are distinct realizations of the same typed hypotheses, not metaphors for one another. Each law is stated in the six-part normal form inherited from Foundations IV, with an obstruction or falsifier, an exactly-one status partition where applicable, a proof spine, interaction discipline, and explicit nonclaims. D1–D6 and the core E1–E16 laws are represented in the companion Lean 4 development and finite Repair-World/law-specific campaign; two named interpretive corollaries, Alarm Fatigue and Operational Selfhood, remain unformalized and are marked accordingly. The finite campaign contains 348 preregistered comparisons across fifteen law-specific result artifacts, all passing. Existing particle and neural substrate experiments supply life-facing null, drive, maintenance, motif, and intervention evidence under explicit nonclaims, while an unrun planarian-regeneration protocol states a concrete biological promotion target and its falsifiers. No definition of biological life, consciousness, death, welfare, or autonomous evolution is claimed.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Earlier work in the Six-Bird program supplies six primitive role families ( P_1, ,P_6 — descent, representability, route mismatch, refinement, packaging, audit), an admissibility and exact-six scope discipline over FATCD , inherited status, threshold, visibility, and audit machinery, and concrete model fragments such as PICA and Cantor. It does not, however, supply a paper-level finite interaction calculus that records, in one finite typed framework, how the six primitive roles interact, how typed directed cells are judged, how defects induce statuses, how promotion is audited, and how model realizations are scoped. This paper constructs , a finite audited typed calculus for six-bird interaction. The calculus carries finite typed schemas of theory packages, instruments, visibility and suppression records, witness and update families, role-channel, directed-cell, pair-observable, promotion, dependency, and no-go judgments, defect records, statuses, gates, audit records, and model-realization maps. Every component is finite, admissibility is checked on finite records, and every claim is recorded under an explicit host or instrument together with a nonclaim register. The main theorem groups are: no total six-symbol algebra; typed non-collapse and status-family separation; finite well-formedness and covered-cell status uniqueness; descent, closure-deficit, completion, saturation, strict-extension, and definability results; graph and cohomology no-drive results; promotion-gate soundness; and no-overreading and finite rotating-audit theorems. The numbered stack comprises theorem-grade Theorems 1–28 and 30–32, model-grade Model Theorems 29, 33, and 34, and audit-grade Proposition 35. The repository includes a Lean 4 validation track, pinned to leanprover/lean4:v4.28.0, whose manifest-driven strict validator audits the paper-to-Lean declaration coverage. The mathematical content of these theorems is standard — descent through a finite quotient, idempotent saturation, the Kullback–Leibler decomposition, finite cycle/cochain duality, the universal property of the image factorization, and so on — and is not claimed as novel; what the paper contributes is the calculus, its scope discipline, the countermodel atlas, and the explicit nonclaim register within which these results are restated and used. Twelve countermodels CM_1 – CM_ 12 each block a specific overclaim, and four scoped model-realization statements cover finite stochastic PICA, audited Cantor shells, finite abstract-interpretation hosts, and finite graph and cohomology supports. Each model realization is host-bound, fragment-scoped, and certified at claim-strength model_realization rather than theorem-grade accepted. The paper does not prove a universal exact-six theorem, a universal six-symbol algebra, a unique decomposition theorem, an empirical realization claim, or complete same-level self-certification.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: A distinct case occurs when promotion is available only after context or protocol state is internalized into the package. We call this protocol-indexed promotion. The base candidate does not qualify honestly on its own, because its apparent success depends on omitted protocol state, but an internalized or explicitly indexed version satisfies the promoted-package criterion once that dependence is represented inside the state object. This is stronger than a mere artifact diagnosis and weaker than intrinsic promotion: the route remains live, but only as an indexed package rather than as a context-free one.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: This appendix collects the formal definitions and theorem statements used in the main text. At the level of general mathematical form, the quotient and factorization language used here sits near behavioral equivalence, bisimulation, exact aggregation, and standard quotient-factorization arguments . It does not reproduce proofs. The comparison base is inherited from the first three papers of the series: fixed support and admissibility, the current and predictive quotients on single histories, and the branchwise and recombination quotients on branch assemblages. The present paper uses those inherited structures only to define and compare the flagship recombination family on a common exact-finite support. At the single-history level, the current quotient Q_i identifies reachable histories that are indistinguishable by the current event package, while the predictive quotient M_i identifies histories that remain indistinguishable under all admissible future generator/observable words on the reachable image. At the branch-assemblage level, the branchwise quotient K_i identifies assemblages with the same weighted multiset of predictive classes, while the recombination quotient R_i identifies assemblages that are indistinguishable by admissible later recombination observables. When recombination equivalence refines branchwise equivalence there is a canonical forgetful map _i : R_i → K_i .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Earlier fixed-support papers in Six Birds Theory introduced admissible event packages, predictive quotients, and recombination witnesses. They left open whether a recombination-positive witness family supports a genuine promoted package or only a lower-layer summary. We answer that question on a frozen Route A corpus. We define a promotion criterion requiring sufficiency on the designated observable surface, induced update closure, admissible second-stage stability, control admissibility, protocol honesty, and slice legibility. The corpus is exact-finite and controlled: a two-anchor flagship core, four nearby positives, and matched null, memory-only, artifact, and boundary-sensitive controls, together with a support-only erasure comparison surface. We replace an earlier vacuous second-stage rule with an admissible surface-coarsening audit and treat the artifact control in paired protocol-aware form. On this pipeline, an intrinsic candidate package survives on both flagship anchors, covers the four nearby positives, preserves the required control contrasts, and remains honest under the paired artifact audit. Two representative-selected route families also survive on the flagship core, but only as secondary evidence: they do not support a unique best strategy and they do not displace the intrinsic survivor. Slice/dual analyses are support-only and the staging–packaging defect atlas is explanatory. A Lean criterion kernel formalizes the promotion vocabulary and the generic implication from the criterion fields to promoted-package status. The resulting claim is narrow: at least one promoted-package candidate survives honestly on fixed support in the Route A flagship family.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: This paper isolates a control-stable intrinsic family inside the fixed-support recombination layer of Six Birds theory. The first three papers of the series established admissible event packages on fixed support, predictive quotients on single histories, and the branchwise and recombination quotients on branch assemblages. Here we identify a two-anchor relative-cycle family in which branchwise predictive agreement does not determine later recombination observables. We instantiate the standard factorized no-interference collapse on the flagship surface, exhibit exact-finite separation for two flagship anchors, and formalize a concrete Lean witness kernel for the reference-positive anchor, including a no-factorization corollary. We separate the flagship positives from classical mixture, hidden predictive memory, protocol artifact, and boundary-collapse or completion-sensitive negatives using an explicit matched control bundle. We also show that nearby exact positives exist within the same relative-cycle family, while the erasure side remains empirical support rather than formal core.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The preceding carrier-exactification paper established a scoped carrier layer on the Route A flagship support: a lawful same-branch witness, a non-faithful public signature shadow, a protocol-indexed carrier surface, scoped quadratic carrying, and two proto-event and proto-test pilots. We ask whether this carrier structure supports admissible event and test structure on fixed support. The central construct is an event bridge record B_E=(C,P,I,L,V, ,S,A) binding a carrier-side predicate, a public/readout-side predicate, an instrument, a selected lift or forgetting map, a visibility and suppression record, a threshold record, an exact-six role profile, and an audit record. A deterministic artifact pipeline generates candidate events, constructs bridge records, applies an admissibility gate, runs controls, scores layer placement, attempts finite test-family construction, and records the consequences for shared-event identity, proto-effect structure, quadratic alignment, and exact-six bookkeeping. From a pool of seventeen candidates, two inherited scoped positives — a quadratic level-set event and a transition-stability test — are accepted at the event gate and retained under controls as protocol-indexed event-level objects. No finite admissible test family is accepted: the one serious protocol-indexed bridge-family candidate is non-exhaustive because a required readout-agreement slot is unrealized. The scoped quadratic families organize the accepted q-levelset event boundary at event level but not at test level. The resulting classification is accepted scoped protocol-indexed event-level structure without accepted tests, shared-event identity, or proto-effect operations.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The structural laws of the Six Birds corpus through Foundations IV are stated from the standpoint of an external theorist: the theorist declares a lens, detects an obstruction, installs a repair, prices a residual, and runs the audit. This paper makes the closure apparatus part of the carrier. An endogenous closure system carries its own instruments, ledgers, repair generator, boundary records, and re-audit loop, and its claims of self-repair are admitted only when the relevant records are produced by its own transitions under a closed-loop source policy. Six definitions (D1–D6) and sixteen laws (E1–E16) give the resulting catalog: endogenous repair, bounded reflexivity, self-maintenance, repair compilation and collapse; priced exposure, alarm, control prices, and probe acquisition; stack rewrite, individuation, and repair transport; and reconsolidation, offline reclosure, and adaptability. The laws are carrier-side and substrate-independent. Living, cognitive, and social systems therefore enter on equal terms: physiological regulation and organismal maintenance, agent-side learning and control, and institutional reproduction and rewrite are distinct realizations of the same typed hypotheses, not metaphors for one another. Each law is stated in the six-part normal form inherited from Foundations IV, with an obstruction or falsifier, an exactly-one status partition where applicable, a proof spine, interaction discipline, and explicit nonclaims. D1–D6 and the core E1–E16 laws are represented in the companion Lean 4 development and finite Repair-World/law-specific campaign; two named interpretive corollaries, Alarm Fatigue and Operational Selfhood, remain unformalized and are marked accordingly. The finite campaign contains 348 preregistered comparisons across fifteen law-specific result artifacts, all passing. Existing particle and neural substrate experiments supply life-facing null, drive, maintenance, motif, and intervention evidence under explicit nonclaims, while an unrun planarian-regeneration protocol states a concrete biological promotion target and its falsifiers. No definition of biological life, consciousness, death, welfare, or autonomous evolution is claimed.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The paper establishes a substrate-level result. On a fixed-support Six Birds architecture, branchwise predictive structure and recombination-sensitive structure can be separated operationally, and that separation can be audited under exact finite controls. The benchmark suite shows that the same substrate supports a classical-mixture null regime, hidden predictive memory without additional recombination sensitivity, readable-route suppression, erased conditional recovery, bounded cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. The formal contribution is narrower. The Lean development proves an abstract refinement layer under detectability, a factorized no-interference regime in which the recombination quotient collapses to the branchwise quotient, and the corresponding obstruction result that strict refinement rules out global branchwise factorization. It also proves one theorem-backed concrete positive instance for an aligned Lean model of the promoted family n5_d1_w1of4_3of4 . These results support the interpretation of the benchmark suite but do not replace it.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The accepted strict-test families are partitions of the closed three-slot domain at each carrier. Building a proto-effect fragment would require identifying effect-shaped structure in those families that survives the foundations claim discipline; building an effect algebra would require composition-respecting operations on such effects across the three carriers; a Born valuation would require a state-functional pairing whose values respect the effect-algebra structure; and composition readiness would require the algebraic and state-side constructions to combine coherently. Each step is a separate structural construction beyond the strict-test acceptance reported in Paper 9. Under , absence of those constructions is a nonclaim boundary, not an implied consequence of the accepted tests. The blockers are constructive rather than refutative. These higher structures remain possible targets for later work; the present paper neither constructs them nor rules them out. The claim-boundary discipline of keeps them explicit as nonclaims, and the claim-boundary control of verifies on the audit side that the accepted families respect that boundary.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We study recombination-sensitive branch structure on a fixed-support substrate in Six Birds Theory. Building on prior work on event packaging and predictive holonomy, we introduce branch assemblages and two quotient levels at an interface: a branchwise predictive quotient ( K_i ), which captures independent predictive treatment of the branches, and a recombination quotient ( R_i ), which captures admissible recombination observables on branch families. On this architecture we exhibit a benchmark suite separating classical mixture, hidden predictive memory without recombination sensitivity, route-marked suppression, erasure-conditioned recovery, cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. A supporting theorem layer proves the abstract factorized no-interference regime and its obstruction by strict refinement, and one promoted positive family is connected to a theorem-backed concrete witness in an aligned Lean model. We do not claim a general reconstruction of non-Hilbert interference or a formalization of the full benchmark runtime. The claim is narrower: these recombination phenomena arise on fixed support, can be audited exactly, and admit a partial formal backbone on the Six Birds substrate.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: This appendix collects the formal definitions and theorem statements used in the main text. At the level of general mathematical form, the quotient and factorization language used here sits near behavioral equivalence, bisimulation, exact aggregation, and standard quotient-factorization arguments . It does not reproduce proofs. The comparison base is inherited from the first three papers of the series: fixed support and admissibility, the current and predictive quotients on single histories, and the branchwise and recombination quotients on branch assemblages. The present paper uses those inherited structures only to define and compare the flagship recombination family on a common exact-finite support. At the single-history level, the current quotient Q_i identifies reachable histories that are indistinguishable by the current event package, while the predictive quotient M_i identifies histories that remain indistinguishable under all admissible future generator/observable words on the reachable image. At the branch-assemblage level, the branchwise quotient K_i identifies assemblages with the same weighted multiset of predictive classes, while the recombination quotient R_i identifies assemblages that are indistinguishable by admissible later recombination observables. When recombination equivalence refines branchwise equivalence there is a canonical forgetful map _i : R_i → K_i .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The paper establishes a substrate-level result. On a fixed-support Six Birds architecture, branchwise predictive structure and recombination-sensitive structure can be separated operationally, and that separation can be audited under exact finite controls. The benchmark suite shows that the same substrate supports a classical-mixture null regime, hidden predictive memory without additional recombination sensitivity, readable-route suppression, erased conditional recovery, bounded cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. The formal contribution is narrower. The Lean development proves an abstract refinement layer under detectability, a factorized no-interference regime in which the recombination quotient collapses to the branchwise quotient, and the corresponding obstruction result that strict refinement rules out global branchwise factorization. It also proves one theorem-backed concrete positive instance for an aligned Lean model of the promoted family n5_d1_w1of4_3of4 . These results support the interpretation of the benchmark suite but do not replace it.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Next-token prediction is not, by itself, a theory of compositional content: finite predictive statistics can agree while the induced quotients compose differently under larger contexts. We study an alternative, non-gradient formulation in which a language model is an audited ledger of finite theory extensions rather than a parameter vector. Six Birds Theory (SBT) supplies the admissibility calculus: typed closure-package layers, explicit quotient maps, audit records, nonclaim records, and promotion gates based on descent, stability, control, no-smuggling, legibility, and strict factorization failure. We introduce Language Theory Models (LTMs), a prototype architecture for structural recovery on fixed sequence corpora. An LTM accumulates typed transition evidence, monitors each active layer with a conditional-information closure-deficit statistic and an idempotence/self-consistency defect, and proposes new layers only when the current quotient leaves recoverable structure unresolved. Candidate layers are committed only after an explicit gate panel emits a strict-extension certificate; otherwise the runtime records a typed defect or remains silent rather than laundering fallback evidence into a stronger claim. We report a code-backed feasibility study on Shakespeare: the runtime builds closure-package layers, records promotion attempts and failures, emits halt verdicts, caps unaudited fallback readout, and demonstrates strict R-layer growth in bounded runs. Independent of the LTM runtime, we provide a structural probe suite that tests SBT framework-level commitments under blue-team and red-team cases, including growth, forgetting, uncertainty, auditability, and concept-separation scenarios. The contribution is a concrete audited substrate for testing whether compositional structure in a fixed corpus can be recovered as a finite ladder of certified theory refinements.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The structural laws of the Six Birds corpus through Foundations IV are stated from the standpoint of an external theorist: the theorist declares a lens, detects an obstruction, installs a repair, prices a residual, and runs the audit. This paper makes the closure apparatus part of the carrier. An endogenous closure system carries its own instruments, ledgers, repair generator, boundary records, and re-audit loop, and its claims of self-repair are admitted only when the relevant records are produced by its own transitions under a closed-loop source policy. Six definitions (D1–D6) and sixteen laws (E1–E16) give the resulting catalog: endogenous repair, bounded reflexivity, self-maintenance, repair compilation and collapse; priced exposure, alarm, control prices, and probe acquisition; stack rewrite, individuation, and repair transport; and reconsolidation, offline reclosure, and adaptability. The laws are carrier-side and substrate-independent. Living, cognitive, and social systems therefore enter on equal terms: physiological regulation and organismal maintenance, agent-side learning and control, and institutional reproduction and rewrite are distinct realizations of the same typed hypotheses, not metaphors for one another. Each law is stated in the six-part normal form inherited from Foundations IV, with an obstruction or falsifier, an exactly-one status partition where applicable, a proof spine, interaction discipline, and explicit nonclaims. D1–D6 and the core E1–E16 laws are represented in the companion Lean 4 development and finite Repair-World/law-specific campaign; two named interpretive corollaries, Alarm Fatigue and Operational Selfhood, remain unformalized and are marked accordingly. The finite campaign contains 348 preregistered comparisons across fifteen law-specific result artifacts, all passing. Existing particle and neural substrate experiments supply life-facing null, drive, maintenance, motif, and intervention evidence under explicit nonclaims, while an unrun planarian-regeneration protocol states a concrete biological promotion target and its falsifiers. No definition of biological life, consciousness, death, welfare, or autonomous evolution is claimed.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Across disciplines, stable descriptive layers rely on small sets of variables that budget feasibility, accumulate along protocols, or appear as exchange rates between incompatible objectives. We call such variables currencies. This paper gives a layer-relative definition of currency within the Six Birds closure calculus and proposes a currency–constraint principle: lower-layer currencies become higher-layer constraints because packaged higher-level objects can persist only under bounded lower-layer spending, while higher-layer currencies emerge as the shadow prices of those budgets. In finite Markov laboratories this principle becomes measurable. Path-reversal asymmetry and cycle affinities furnish lower-layer audits; constrained maximum-entropy closure yields dual prices; and across a resolution ladder we observe five robust signatures: honest coarse-grained directionality, monotone price emergence with a slack regime, growth of currency dimension with resolution, failure of proxy currencies under prediction and dual stability, and improved packaging coherence under stronger budget enforcement. A Lean formalization proves deterministic-pushforward monotonicity for a finite KL form, providing a formal anchor for the audit side of the story. The result is a practical and conceptual account of why temperatures, prices, regularizers, and attention weights recur across sciences as the same mathematical kind of object.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The structural laws of the Six Birds corpus through Foundations IV are stated from the standpoint of an external theorist: the theorist declares a lens, detects an obstruction, installs a repair, prices a residual, and runs the audit. This paper makes the closure apparatus part of the carrier. An endogenous closure system carries its own instruments, ledgers, repair generator, boundary records, and re-audit loop, and its claims of self-repair are admitted only when the relevant records are produced by its own transitions under a closed-loop source policy. Six definitions (D1–D6) and sixteen laws (E1–E16) give the resulting catalog: endogenous repair, bounded reflexivity, self-maintenance, repair compilation and collapse; priced exposure, alarm, control prices, and probe acquisition; stack rewrite, individuation, and repair transport; and reconsolidation, offline reclosure, and adaptability. The laws are carrier-side and substrate-independent. Living, cognitive, and social systems therefore enter on equal terms: physiological regulation and organismal maintenance, agent-side learning and control, and institutional reproduction and rewrite are distinct realizations of the same typed hypotheses, not metaphors for one another. Each law is stated in the six-part normal form inherited from Foundations IV, with an obstruction or falsifier, an exactly-one status partition where applicable, a proof spine, interaction discipline, and explicit nonclaims. D1–D6 and the core E1–E16 laws are represented in the companion Lean 4 development and finite Repair-World/law-specific campaign; two named interpretive corollaries, Alarm Fatigue and Operational Selfhood, remain unformalized and are marked accordingly. The finite campaign contains 348 preregistered comparisons across fifteen law-specific result artifacts, all passing. Existing particle and neural substrate experiments supply life-facing null, drive, maintenance, motif, and intervention evidence under explicit nonclaims, while an unrun planarian-regeneration protocol states a concrete biological promotion target and its falsifiers. No definition of biological life, consciousness, death, welfare, or autonomous evolution is claimed.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The anti-relabeling ledger is part of the result. This paper does not claim the predictive-state or causal-state quotient construction as new; that is a standard way to summarize a process by its predictive consequences . It does not claim the closure-deficit identity, or the optimality of the best autonomous macro-predictor, as new; those are imported from the closure-deficit and no-go accounts . It does not claim the strict-extension, saturation, or promotion-obligation framework as new; those are imported standards for recognizing when a higher vocabulary is a genuine layer rather than a relabeling . Nor does it claim as new the game-theoretic fact that added structure matters. Folk theorems show that repeated interaction can support many outcomes; global games show how noisy private information can select; reputation models show how type structure changes play; evolutionary and stochastic-stability models show that convention selection can be a property of a run; correlated equilibrium and type spaces show how signals and hidden state enlarge the game . These are reference points the paper uses, not results it rebrands. The contribution is the conjunction, on one explicit repeated-game object, under one evidentiary discipline. First, the paper installs the predictive state as the canonical institution of repeated play and verifies, on the finite carrier, that it is not definable from the game's own stage vocabulary: the institutional partition strictly refines the stage partition and does not factor through it. Second, the paper prices the omission exactly by closure deficit, with a gap–residual decomposition that separates what conditioning on the institution recovers from what remains unpredictable even after that conditioning. Third, it assembles these facts into a certified strict-extension object: the institutional vocabulary saturates, admits an active label-feedback exhibit under a declared extension, and passes the admissibility gates for a promoted layer on the carrier. Fourth, the picture is subjected to tests that could have failed silently but were reported in full: the run-layer constants are reproducible within protocol yet fail three frozen out-of-sample transfer attempts, and the human-data analysis confirms the predictive-residue hypothesis while reversing the proposed timing bridge. The registered negatives are not qualifications to the result; they are part of the evidence for the strict-extension reading.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The structural laws of the Six Birds corpus through Foundations IV are stated from the standpoint of an external theorist: the theorist declares a lens, detects an obstruction, installs a repair, prices a residual, and runs the audit. This paper makes the closure apparatus part of the carrier. An endogenous closure system carries its own instruments, ledgers, repair generator, boundary records, and re-audit loop, and its claims of self-repair are admitted only when the relevant records are produced by its own transitions under a closed-loop source policy. Six definitions (D1–D6) and sixteen laws (E1–E16) give the resulting catalog: endogenous repair, bounded reflexivity, self-maintenance, repair compilation and collapse; priced exposure, alarm, control prices, and probe acquisition; stack rewrite, individuation, and repair transport; and reconsolidation, offline reclosure, and adaptability. The laws are carrier-side and substrate-independent. Living, cognitive, and social systems therefore enter on equal terms: physiological regulation and organismal maintenance, agent-side learning and control, and institutional reproduction and rewrite are distinct realizations of the same typed hypotheses, not metaphors for one another. Each law is stated in the six-part normal form inherited from Foundations IV, with an obstruction or falsifier, an exactly-one status partition where applicable, a proof spine, interaction discipline, and explicit nonclaims. D1–D6 and the core E1–E16 laws are represented in the companion Lean 4 development and finite Repair-World/law-specific campaign; two named interpretive corollaries, Alarm Fatigue and Operational Selfhood, remain unformalized and are marked accordingly. The finite campaign contains 348 preregistered comparisons across fifteen law-specific result artifacts, all passing. Existing particle and neural substrate experiments supply life-facing null, drive, maintenance, motif, and intervention evidence under explicit nonclaims, while an unrun planarian-regeneration protocol states a concrete biological promotion target and its falsifiers. No definition of biological life, consciousness, death, welfare, or autonomous evolution is claimed.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The anti-relabeling ledger is part of the result. This paper does not claim the predictive-state or causal-state quotient construction as new; that is a standard way to summarize a process by its predictive consequences . It does not claim the closure-deficit identity, or the optimality of the best autonomous macro-predictor, as new; those are imported from the closure-deficit and no-go accounts . It does not claim the strict-extension, saturation, or promotion-obligation framework as new; those are imported standards for recognizing when a higher vocabulary is a genuine layer rather than a relabeling . Nor does it claim as new the game-theoretic fact that added structure matters. Folk theorems show that repeated interaction can support many outcomes; global games show how noisy private information can select; reputation models show how type structure changes play; evolutionary and stochastic-stability models show that convention selection can be a property of a run; correlated equilibrium and type spaces show how signals and hidden state enlarge the game . These are reference points the paper uses, not results it rebrands. The contribution is the conjunction, on one explicit repeated-game object, under one evidentiary discipline. First, the paper installs the predictive state as the canonical institution of repeated play and verifies, on the finite carrier, that it is not definable from the game's own stage vocabulary: the institutional partition strictly refines the stage partition and does not factor through it. Second, the paper prices the omission exactly by closure deficit, with a gap–residual decomposition that separates what conditioning on the institution recovers from what remains unpredictable even after that conditioning. Third, it assembles these facts into a certified strict-extension object: the institutional vocabulary saturates, admits an active label-feedback exhibit under a declared extension, and passes the admissibility gates for a promoted layer on the carrier. Fourth, the picture is subjected to tests that could have failed silently but were reported in full: the run-layer constants are reproducible within protocol yet fail three frozen out-of-sample transfer attempts, and the human-data analysis confirms the predictive-residue hypothesis while reversing the proposed timing bridge. The registered negatives are not qualifications to the result; they are part of the evidence for the strict-extension reading.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We ask not merely whether layer birth occurs, but how many primitive kinds of birth are experimentally accessible. Within the Six-Birds framework, birth events can be organized by activation of packaging ( P5 ), directed circulation ( P6_ drive ), and staging anomaly ( P4 ). We show that these primitives support a small canonical taxonomy of four layer-birth classes and that the corresponding classes can be operationally instantiated and separated in a common measured observable space. Class-I activates packaging without drive; Class-II activates packaging together with directed circulation; Class-III activates packaging together with a staging anomaly but without drive; and Class-IV activates all three. The strongest empirical separation is between Class-I and Class-II, where affinity at structural birth robustly discriminates drive-free from driven births and explicit no-fake-arrow controls rule out coarse-graining artifacts. We then place all four classes on a shared observable map using structural boundary location, affinity at boundary, and a strict-rule-aligned staging proxy. Capacity/depth behaves as a post-birth field rather than a primary classifier, and at least one upstream/PICA-style system can be embedded in the same coordinate system. We do not claim stabilized universality exponents. Instead, we provide a primitive taxonomy and observable separation of layer-birth classes that future universality work must respect.

The strongest empirical separation is between Class-I and Class-II, where affinity at structural birth robustly discriminates drive-free from driven births and explicit no-fake-arrow controls rule out coarse-graining artifacts. We then place all four classes on a shared observable map using structural boundary location, affinity at boundary, and a strict-rule-aligned staging proxy. Capacity/depth behaves as a post-birth field rather than a primary classifier, and at least one upstream/PICA-style system can be embedded in the same coordinate system. We do not claim stabilized universality exponents. Instead, we provide a primitive taxonomy and observable separation of layer-birth classes that future universality work must respect.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Work on multi-scale organization and audit-based directionality lacks a minimal-substrate theorem: key primitives are often realized only by smuggling in external schedules, ad hoc audits, or declared quotients, making results hard to verify and compare across substrates. We introduce a no-smuggling minimal-substrate semantics for SPT, operationalize it via matched-control audit tests on finite stochastic machines, and demonstrate separations between protocol artifacts, intrinsic drive, and route-dependent packaging defects. Operationally, we define a canonical machine class S_ of autonomous finite stochastic dynamics with phase-in-state, deterministic lenses, induced packaging endomaps E_ ,f , and intrinsic audits (path-reversal KL asymmetry _T and ACC affinities), and we implement exact computations together with a reproducible witness suite and a Lean-checked idempotent/closure backbone for packaging equivalence and saturation . Under calibrated controls, stroboscopic protocols can exhibit _T>0 while their autonomous lifts yield _T 0 (protocol trap), whereas turning on internal phase drive produces a clean null-vs-driven separation with _T(Z)>0 and a detectable projected macro arrow; moreover deterministic coarse-graining never increases _T and can erase it entirely, and packaging along refinement routes exhibits a prototype-driven holonomy defect that is large at moderate timescales while a uniform baseline is near zero and satisfies a gain-plus-mismatch bound. These results supply a machine semantics and separation witnesses for a minimal substrate theorem, reducing false positives and turning SPT from a language into a compilation target up to packaging equivalence. We are explicit that we do not establish a universal physical substrate or continuum limit: our conclusions are semantic and rest on exact finite-state audits and controlled constructions rather than empirical natural-system data.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Many sciences rely on maps of macroscopic behavior—phase diagrams, stability charts, bifurcation sets, and feasibility regions—but emergence itself is rarely treated as a mapping problem. We introduce emergence atlases: subsets and scalar fields on control space indicating where a macro-description is feasible. In the finite-state setting used here, feasibility means that a packaged description is simultaneously closed, nontrivial, audit-safe, and budget-feasible. We compute such atlases in three settings: analytic law families, full packaging spaces of small systems, and the PICA mechanism algebra. The resulting maps recover exact closure loci and reversible lines, expose multi-objective tradeoffs among closure, directionality, effective information, novelty slack, and budget, and identify mechanism-space regimes together with their sensitive ablations and conservative compact supports. These computations support a simple reframing: emergence is usefully treated as a phase-diagram problem for effective theories in control space. In that view, effective information, irreversibility, coarse-graining quality, and mechanism-space analyses appear not as rival definitions of emergence, but as slices of a larger atlas.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: [label= .,leftmargin=*] The exact carrier results are scoped to the declared finite carrier: the memory-one reactive catalog, the two payoff families, the uniform prior, and the declared lenses, rounds, horizons, and extensions. They are not general theorems about all repeated games. The no-shortcut conclusion concerns the tested low-complexity formula classes and the three frozen transfer tests. It is not a proof that no transferable shortcut exists. The run constants are scoped to the declared payoff families, stochastic dynamics, population sizes, noise grids, estimators, and execution protocols. Changing any of these can change the measured constant. The human-data analysis concerns one published dataset under one frozen protocol. It neither validates nor invalidates any carrier theorem, and the memory-one strategy-space alignment is a shared language rather than a bridge theorem. The material-forcing result holds relative to its declared label-feedback extension. It is not a claim that public institutional labels generally enrich play. resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.
