resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We ask not merely whether layer birth occurs, but how many primitive kinds of birth are experimentally accessible. Within the Six-Birds framework, birth events can be organized by activation of packaging ( P5 ), directed circulation ( P6_ drive ), and staging anomaly ( P4 ). We show that these primitives support a small canonical taxonomy of four layer-birth classes and that the corresponding classes can be operationally instantiated and separated in a common measured observable space. Class-I activates packaging without drive; Class-II activates packaging together with directed circulation; Class-III activates packaging together with a staging anomaly but without drive; and Class-IV activates all three. The strongest empirical separation is between Class-I and Class-II, where affinity at structural birth robustly discriminates drive-free from driven births and explicit no-fake-arrow controls rule out coarse-graining artifacts. We then place all four classes on a shared observable map using structural boundary location, affinity at boundary, and a strict-rule-aligned staging proxy. Capacity/depth behaves as a post-birth field rather than a primary classifier, and at least one upstream/PICA-style system can be embedded in the same coordinate system. We do not claim stabilized universality exponents. Instead, we provide a primitive taxonomy and observable separation of layer-birth classes that future universality work must respect.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Work on multi-scale organization and audit-based directionality lacks a minimal-substrate theorem: key primitives are often realized only by smuggling in external schedules, ad hoc audits, or declared quotients, making results hard to verify and compare across substrates. We introduce a no-smuggling minimal-substrate semantics for SPT, operationalize it via matched-control audit tests on finite stochastic machines, and demonstrate separations between protocol artifacts, intrinsic drive, and route-dependent packaging defects. Operationally, we define a canonical machine class S_ of autonomous finite stochastic dynamics with phase-in-state, deterministic lenses, induced packaging endomaps E_ ,f , and intrinsic audits (path-reversal KL asymmetry _T and ACC affinities), and we implement exact computations together with a reproducible witness suite and a Lean-checked idempotent/closure backbone for packaging equivalence and saturation . Under calibrated controls, stroboscopic protocols can exhibit _T>0 while their autonomous lifts yield _T 0 (protocol trap), whereas turning on internal phase drive produces a clean null-vs-driven separation with _T(Z)>0 and a detectable projected macro arrow; moreover deterministic coarse-graining never increases _T and can erase it entirely, and packaging along refinement routes exhibits a prototype-driven holonomy defect that is large at moderate timescales while a uniform baseline is near zero and satisfies a gain-plus-mismatch bound. These results supply a machine semantics and separation witnesses for a minimal substrate theorem, reducing false positives and turning SPT from a language into a compilation target up to packaging equivalence. We are explicit that we do not establish a universal physical substrate or continuum limit: our conclusions are semantic and rest on exact finite-state audits and controlled constructions rather than empirical natural-system data.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Many sciences rely on maps of macroscopic behavior—phase diagrams, stability charts, bifurcation sets, and feasibility regions—but emergence itself is rarely treated as a mapping problem. We introduce emergence atlases: subsets and scalar fields on control space indicating where a macro-description is feasible. In the finite-state setting used here, feasibility means that a packaged description is simultaneously closed, nontrivial, audit-safe, and budget-feasible. We compute such atlases in three settings: analytic law families, full packaging spaces of small systems, and the PICA mechanism algebra. The resulting maps recover exact closure loci and reversible lines, expose multi-objective tradeoffs among closure, directionality, effective information, novelty slack, and budget, and identify mechanism-space regimes together with their sensitive ablations and conservative compact supports. These computations support a simple reframing: emergence is usefully treated as a phase-diagram problem for effective theories in control space. In that view, effective information, irreversibility, coarse-graining quality, and mechanism-space analyses appear not as rival definitions of emergence, but as slices of a larger atlas.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: What makes a mathematical object useful when it does not live in the layer where the problem is posed? Imaginary numbers are not real, infinitesimals are not real scalars, roots of irreducible polynomials need not lie in the base field, and cohomology classes are not vertex potentials. This paper studies that pattern by separating a lower layer, where a problem and its accepted answers are stated, from a promoted layer, where additional objects may be available. We define theory layers, promotion bridges, audited descending expressions, and the Strict Audited Utility (SAU) certificate, and then show that SAU is extracted from strict useful traces rather than stipulated. The main results are a theorem stack: Essential Boundary Necessity (Theorem A), which forces hidden promoted support and an audited lower boundary; SAU Boundary Normal Form (Theorem B); a Partial Converse and Tautology Barrier (Theorem C); SAU Soundness (Theorem D); Basic Profile Classification (Theorem E); four canonical witnesses from imaginary numbers, dual numbers and first jets, Galois roots, and graph cohomology; Minimality and universal promotion (Theorem F); and a Profile Transfer theorem (Theorem G). Together they show that, in finite typed audited promoted-use traces, strict mathematical usefulness forces hidden non-descent plus audited boundary descent. The claim is deliberately scoped: the paper does not claim that all mathematics is useful, does not literalize hidden objects downstairs, and does not claim that the Lean development independently proves every paper theorem. The Lean material is a traceability harness, with substantive proof language reserved for direct, computational, and definitional proof rows.

Together they show that, in finite typed audited promoted-use traces, strict mathematical usefulness forces hidden non-descent plus audited boundary descent. The claim is deliberately scoped: the paper does not claim that all mathematics is useful, does not literalize hidden objects downstairs, and does not claim that the Lean development independently proves every paper theorem. The Lean material is a traceability harness, with substantive proof language reserved for direct, computational, and definitional proof rows.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Earlier papers in the fixed-support line of Six Birds Theory established admissible event packages, predictive and recombination quotients, a control-stable Route A flagship corpus, promotion criteria, and the intrinsic promoted-package survivor. They left open the internal carrier status of that survivor. We introduce a carrier-level substrate on the same Route A flagship corpus, consisting of three state-like objects and one structural relation. The three objects are a lawful same-branch witness, a refined witness rung on which the same-branch transport and readout law exactifies; a coarse public signature shadow, which retains public signature role but not lawful transport; and a flagship-only protocol-indexed carrier surface, an autonomous lift of the witness on which protocol coordinates are first-class state data. The structural relation is non-faithful public compression: a projection from the witness to the public shadow that preserves public signature role but does not preserve the refined lawful structure. A seven-criterion exactification audit adapted from standard operational-theory methodology—readout sufficiency, transport and readout law, non-reducibility against the lower quotient baselines, section and protocol honesty, denominator and expansion stress, and cross-seed support—together with a refreshed section/protocol honesty rerun on the lifted flagship patch and a controlled adjacent-surface search stabilises the atlas. Three claim-bearing quadratic families and two proto-event/test families survive on the scoped carrier. Carrier law on the public surface, cross-seed carrier exactification, and full-core carrier exactification are not earned; those non-claims are preserved explicitly. A Lean formal layer records the criterion vocabulary and a typed mirror of the final verdict. The carrier atlas, with its scope and compression structure made explicit, is the substrate carried forward.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We study recombination-sensitive branch structure on a fixed-support substrate in Six Birds Theory. Building on prior work on event packaging and predictive holonomy, we introduce branch assemblages and two quotient levels at an interface: a branchwise predictive quotient ( K_i ), which captures independent predictive treatment of the branches, and a recombination quotient ( R_i ), which captures admissible recombination observables on branch families. On this architecture we exhibit a benchmark suite separating classical mixture, hidden predictive memory without recombination sensitivity, route-marked suppression, erasure-conditioned recovery, cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. A supporting theorem layer proves the abstract factorized no-interference regime and its obstruction by strict refinement, and one promoted positive family is connected to a theorem-backed concrete witness in an aligned Lean model. We do not claim a general reconstruction of non-Hilbert interference or a formalization of the full benchmark runtime. The claim is narrower: these recombination phenomena arise on fixed support, can be audited exactly, and admit a partial formal backbone on the Six Birds substrate.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We introduce a fixed-support route-transport framework in which histories can be equivalent at a current event interface yet differ as predictors of later admissible observations. For each interface, we define a current quotient by present-event indistinguishability and a predictive quotient by equality of all later admissible event statistics under continuation. Standard quotient-algebraic results then apply in this setting: future-predictive equivalence refines current-event equivalence, admissible continuations induce well-defined transport on , and the current class after transport is determined by the source predictive class through a canonical mixed map _i _j . Generic transport on along all outgoing continuations exists precisely at flat interfaces, where current equivalence already determines all future observations. The predictive quotient is future-sufficient, and every future-sufficient state abstraction factors uniquely through on the reachable image. Strict refinement of is equivalent to existence of a pair of histories that are current-equivalent but future-distinct. For endo-continuations, representative push can preserve the current class of every history while moving a predictive class. The contribution of the paper is the framework itself and the demonstration that it is non-vacuous: an axiom-audited finite memory-wheel instance in Lean and exact finite fixed-support benchmarks instantiate strict refinement and the loop asymmetry, while the computational suite separates artifact, flattenable, explicit-latent, dissipative, and coherent-candidate regimes with bounded robustness under perturbation. Small discovery searches recover additional coherent candidates beyond the hand-built examples while a control search space remains all-flat.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: When must an operator-valued obstruction associated with an involutive system vanish? This paper answers that question inside the Six Birds framework by naming Self-Dual Trace Confinement (SDTC) as the recognition source for formed closures with genuine involutive self-duality. The mechanism is the duality-confinement membrane theorem: for an involutive object ledger with separating anti-invariant readout, a sequence of positive domination records B_n with B_n 0 forces the anti-invariant ledger to vanish and confines visible mass to the fixed locus of the duality. The supporting apparatus develops the involutive object ledger, the anti-invariant ledger and trace identity, direct qualitative and quantitative confinement, completed-domination bridges, Douglas factorization in typed-cone form, exhaustive moving ledgers, and optimized scalar trace budgets. Operator-theoretic realization over trace-class operators is an open extension, as is a derivation of the AM–GM step inside a typed real-arithmetic structure. The development is formalized in Lean as a mathlib-free mechanization at the typed positive-cone level (Appendix ). Cross-substrate generalizations such as CPT symmetry, gauge invariance, quantum self-adjointness, and function-field RH are presented as structural predictions, not theorems; the paper develops the abstract apparatus layer and names the hypotheses any substrate-specific application must supply.

The two fundamental equivalence relations are current-event equivalence and future-predictive equivalence. Their quotients define the current quotient Q and the predictive quotient M , with canonical comparison map pi : M → Q induced by refinement. resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The paper establishes a substrate-level result. On a fixed-support Six Birds architecture, branchwise predictive structure and recombination-sensitive structure can be separated operationally, and that separation can be audited under exact finite controls. The benchmark suite shows that the same substrate supports a classical-mixture null regime, hidden predictive memory without additional recombination sensitivity, readable-route suppression, erased conditional recovery, bounded cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. The formal contribution is narrower. The Lean development proves an abstract refinement layer under detectability, a factorized no-interference regime in which the recombination quotient collapses to the branchwise quotient, and the corresponding obstruction result that strict refinement rules out global branchwise factorization. It also proves one theorem-backed concrete positive instance for an aligned Lean model of the promoted family n5_d1_w1of4_3of4 . These results support the interpretation of the benchmark suite but do not replace it.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Randomness is often treated as either ontic indeterminacy or epistemic ignorance. We develop a third, operational account within Six Birds: layer-relative randomness is the predictive residue of non-closure under a chosen packaging and budget. For a micro process X_t and a packaging : X Y , we define the micro-closure deficit at scale by CD_ ( )=I(X_t; Y_ t+ Y_t) , the information about the next packaged state that remains hidden inside the current macro-object. This yields the exact decomposition H(Y_ t+ Y_t)=H(Y_ t+ X_t)+CD_ ( ) , separating intrinsic substrate uncertainty from randomness introduced by discarded distinctions. We connect this exact quantity to computable diagnostics native to earlier Six Birds work, including route mismatch for coarse-grained Markov dynamics and predictive log-loss gaps under limited-memory models. In controlled Markov benchmarks, closure deficit vanishes on exactly lumpable partitions and rises with within-fiber heterogeneity, while route mismatch tracks it closely. In budgeted prediction, increasing memory order buys back hidden distinctions and lowers held-out log loss. In toy hashing, one-wayness and random-lookingness emerge as the same packaging-and-budget phenomenon: high-entropy inputs obey q/2^n inversion scaling, while low-entropy inputs collapse the effect. The result is a measurable account of randomness that unifies coarse-graining, limited prediction, and feasible one-wayness without treating randomness as primitive.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The Six Birds corpus through certifies states: each of its laws fixes a single map, quotient, package, or declared finite family and proves a static classification about it. Nothing in the corpus certifies runs — liveness (every orbit eventually earns a certificate), amortized or transfinite cost over unbounded time, covers that must move with their targets, obstructions that grow, react, or are manufactured by the system's own history, route defects that integrate into potentials, transport that emerges from substrate dynamics, or content that persists through repeated loss. This paper is the catalog of exactly those laws: dynamical structural laws (G1–G13), organized in clusters, each stated in the six-part normal form inherited verbatim from and each carrying a temporal quantifier that no static row possesses. The laws were mined from eccentric mathematical problems — Collatz, Goodstein, Egyptian fractions, reverse-and-add, Recam\'an, the angel problem, sandpiles, rule 184, Ducci, aperiodic tilings, Hadwiger–Nelson, Apollonian packings — treated as theorem detectors: each problem's folklore almost-proof names a promoted object, the object's lawful descended certificate fixes a boundary expression, and the residual surviving comparison against every existing law is the law seed. All thirteen laws are mechanized in Mathlib-free Lean 4 with per-declaration kernel-axiom audits; six laws are full theorem-grade rows and one splits into an unconditional theorem and a schema, four are schema-grade with named boxed hypotheses, and three are calibration-anchored schemas discharged end-to-end by solved classical instances. The paper solves no open problem and claims none: Collatz, Erd o s–Straus, Lychrel, Recam\'an, the Langton's-ant highway, Gilbreath, and the exact chromatic number of the plane all remain open, and each law's nonclaims say so explicitly.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Confluence is usually read as order-independence of reduction, while flatness is usually read as path-independence of transport. This paper argues that their local cores coincide once rewriting is equipped with its missing two-dimensional cells. The relevant object is not the bare reduction graph but a reduction 2-complex whose 0 -cells are states, whose 1 -cells are one-step rewrites, and whose generating 2 -cells are local peaks or, in structured rewriting settings, reachable critical pairs. In that setting, elementary flatness is exactly local confluence. We prove this core equivalence and record the supporting fact that confluence plus normalization yields a unique normal form from a chosen start state. We then show computationally that the corrected local/global picture survives exhaustive finite-ARS stress tests in the terminating regime, curated string-rewriting examples, and a curated left-linear term-rewriting bridge with genuine nonroot overlap. These experiments also show that bare graph-flatness surrogates fail, while reachable critical-pair defects align with the observed local obstruction layer. Finally, explicit before/after examples show that completion can be read as holonomy elimination: the local generator persists while its defect disappears. The full finite terminating left-linear TRS theorem package remains to be written in full generality, but the correct object, local generators, and evidence boundary are now fixed.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Time is often treated as a primitive background parameter, and empirical discussions frequently conflate three distinct notions—event ordering, clock measurement, and irreversible directionality—making it difficult to determine when a layer has time versus when time is an artifact of description. Building on Six Birds Theory (SBT) , we propose a layer-relative account in which time is a closure artifact assembled from stable succession (order), staged repeatable carriers (ticks), and irreversible bookkeeping (arrow). We distinguish causation-time within a fixed closure from enablement-time, where the closure itself is rewritten. We instantiate this account in a finite-state Markov laboratory ( Z=X R ) and operationalize it through an audit-and-control workflow: calibrated null regimes, matched controls, and auto-generated evidence tables from reproducible artifacts. We obtain four controlled separations: (i) in a nearly reversible null regime, arrow proxies are 0 , whereas in a record-coupled driven regime they become decisively nonzero (with absolute irreversibility signaled by EP= ); (ii) under consistent estimation, coarse-graining reduces path-space asymmetry (micro macro), preventing ``fake arrows''; (iii) increasing maintenance budget reduces clock drift and failure, while progress metrics detect stall regimes that would otherwise appear stable; and (iv) closure-defect thresholds trigger theory extension only in an enablement regime (not in a no-birth control), and protocol loops exhibit nonzero holonomy in a noncommuting regime but 0 under a commuting control, obstructing a global time potential. These results provide a reproducible method for separating arrows, clocks, constraints, and protocol effects, and for clarifying when ``instant updates'' reflect constraints and records rather than causal channels. We do not derive physical spacetime here; our conclusions rely on audited proxies in a minimal laboratory together with lightweight mechanized structural lemmas.

hypotheses.text: This section has no counterpart in Foundations IV, and the addition is deliberate: the catalog's laws were not invented and then illustrated, they were mined, and the mining procedure is a first-class contribution of this paper. The raw material is the class of eccentric problems — Collatz, Goodstein, ErdH o s–Straus, Lychrel, Recam\'an, the angel problem, sandpiles, Langton's ant, Ducci, Gilbreath, aperiodic tilings, Hadwiger–Nelson, Apollonian packings — problems that are easy to state, resistant in a characteristic way, and each equipped with a folklore argument that everyone reaches for and that fails. The thesis of the method is that the folklore argument's failure is structured: what it illegitimately assumes is a promoted object, and what would repair it is a descended certificate, and the gap between the two, once it survives comparison against every existing law of the corpus, is a new law. For each problem, in order: Identify the tempting almost-proof — the argument everyone reaches for that fails. The almost-proof reveals the illegal overread. Name the promoted object the almost-proof secretly uses — an invariant measure on a completion, a fixed finite certificate package, a well-founded escrow. Typically the object does not descend to the native carrier. State what a lawful descended certificate would be. This fixes the boundary expression: the native, checkable assertion that promoted support is allowed to purchase ( ). Isolate the residual that survives every existing law. Run the candidate against the full Foundations IV catalog (exact statements, not summaries), the Foundations V laws, the nonclaim register, and the AOR status list. What remains unhandled is the law seed — and this step kills candidates as often as it produces them. Find the siblings. The seed is a law only if the same residual shape appears in at least three independent domains, at least one of them solved (the calibration instance). Otherwise it is a substrate observation, not a law. Admission

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Protocol-driven dynamics often conflate route dependence (noncommutativity/holonomy of update steps) with an arrow of time, making time-asymmetry audits vulnerable to scheduling artifacts. We introduce an autonomous lifted-protocol formulation and a path-reversal audit decomposition, operationalize it via a fully explicit finite-state benchmark, and demonstrate a clean null-versus-driven separation between holonomy and directionality. Concretely, we define two reversible Markov kernels K_0,K_1 on three states and compare (i) an externally scheduled stroboscopic composition on X with (ii) an autonomous time-homogeneous lift on Z=X driven by a clock. Under external scheduling, each step is reversible but the stroboscopic update has strictly positive entropy production EPR , with a noncommutativity witness \|K_0K_1-K_1K_0\|_ = . Under the autonomous lift with a reversible (unbiased) clock (null control), the lifted chain is reversible and the arrow audit collapses to EPR (equivalently, path-reversal asymmetry vanishes). Turning on clock bias (drive) yields a positive arrow and the measured EPR_ lifted matches EPR_ clock across a bias sweep (Figure ). This separation reduces false positives when interpreting protocol effects as directionality and provides a reproducible audit template for switching Markov models and algorithmic protocols. We do not claim a general characterization of all nonequilibrium protocols; the conclusions are for finite-state discrete-time kernels and the random-scan autonomous lift studied here.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Beyond the scope boundaries stated in Section , two further limitations deserve mention. The Lean formalization is intentionally partial: it covers the quotient comparison, predictive and mixed transport, the flatness characterization, sufficiency on the reachable image, witness/strict-refinement equivalence, representative-level loop asymmetry, and a finite non-vacuity instance, but does not yet formalize moved-class sets, cardinality-based nontriviality criteria, or richer action-level invariants. Those omissions do not undermine the present results, but they mark the current boundary of the formal development. The benchmark and discovery labels should also be read operationally rather than ontologically. In particular, coherent_candidate denotes a benchmark or discovered candidate that exhibits the loop asymmetry and witness structure targeted by the paper. It is not a claim that a stronger external state representation has been forced.

Gilbreath's conjecture remains open (the gap-smallness reframing is heuristic). The exact chromatic number of the plane remains open (the bracket is 5 – 7 ). The Catalan–Dickson question for aliquot sequences remains open.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Accounting-style inequalities are central in Six Birds Theory, but they do not by themselves rule out catastrophic extremes: highly localized ``needle'' probes can satisfy global budgets while producing large peaks. We ask when packaging plus accounting forces anti-localization, and propose Reflexive SBT: a capacity-based audit of the packaged artifacts (subspaces, feasibility dictionaries, and route ladders). We define a localization metric _j at cell scale 2^ -j , compute it via an eigenvalue method, and upper-bound it using three auditable capacities: subspace trace/diagonal dispersion, sparse feasibility conditioning on small supports, and a route-union ledger charging multi-route inflation. We find three controlled separations: (i) shift-invariant channels (Fourier/circulant) have uniform projector diagonals and _j follows the deterministic m/2^j bound, while diagonal disorder drives _j rapidly toward 1 compared with full-noise perturbations; (ii) feasibility-level needles arise exactly when small-support conditioning collapses ( sigma_ → 0 ) and are absent in random baselines; (iii) for spectral packaging, route mismatch spikes only at degenerate cutoffs and is eliminated by a canonical tie-break, with remaining route effects captured by the union ledger. This turns the anti-localization hinge into a reproducible checklist and yields a conditional theorem: vanishing capacity implies _j→ 0 along a ladder. We are explicit that Reflexive SBT is not proven here to universally drive capacities to zero; we prove the capacity implies anti-localization implications and provide auditable closure evidence on canonical failure and repair modes.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Previous demonstrations of contextuality-type obstruction start from quantum mechanics or from externally specified measurement scenarios. We show that the same locally-Boolean-but-globally-obstructed structure can arise from an autonomous emergence framework—Six Birds Theory—without importing Hilbert space, amplitudes, or the Born rule. The formal vehicle is a finite event package: a family of stable-record contexts, each carrying a finite Boolean event algebra, together with a layer-relative shared-event identification and an audit layer. Obstruction is the failure of admissible global realization for that package. The computational framework combines exact and quotient-backed feasibility, structural and statistical deficits, provenance auditing, and false-positive controls. The evidence base includes a classical control, a boundary-case epistemic calibration, an explicit finite parity/context witness, and autonomous discovery organized by mechanism, lens, and packaging axes. The results are stratified: mechanism variation yields package-sensitive structure with a quotient-backed witness under a weaker claim ceiling; lens variation closes with a cross-resolution strict extension obstruction on fixed support; and packaging variation produces the strongest current obstruction, subject to a package conflict caveat. Where applicable, the principal cases persist under bounded robustness checks. The paper therefore provides the first computationally explicit evidence that contextuality-type obstruction can emerge from a system's own packaging structure rather than from quantum theory or an externally imposed scenario.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Six Birds theory studies finite systems observed through deterministic coarse-grainings (``lenses'') using a small audited vocabulary of primitives. This paper proves eight no-go theorems that constrain when common emergence narratives can be made honest in a finite, checkable setting. For a finite Markov system and horizon T , define an arrow audit as the Kullback–Leibler divergence between the observed path law and its time reversal. We prove a deterministic data-processing inequality: observation cannot increase arrow. As a consequence, any reversible system started in stationarity has zero observed arrow, even when the observation supports nontrivial protocol structure. Further results give graph-theoretic obstructions for force-like antisymmetric drives (exactness on forests and zero cycle sums), a finite variational identity for best macro-kernels and closure deficit, and a bounded-interface saturation theorem that prevents unbounded laddering. Together these theorems delimit what can and cannot be certified as emergent from audited primitives in finite models.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: When must an operator-valued obstruction associated with an involutive system vanish? This paper answers that question inside the Six Birds framework by naming Self-Dual Trace Confinement (SDTC) as the recognition source for formed closures with genuine involutive self-duality. The mechanism is the duality-confinement membrane theorem: for an involutive object ledger with separating anti-invariant readout, a sequence of positive domination records B_n with B_n 0 forces the anti-invariant ledger to vanish and confines visible mass to the fixed locus of the duality. The supporting apparatus develops the involutive object ledger, the anti-invariant ledger and trace identity, direct qualitative and quantitative confinement, completed-domination bridges, Douglas factorization in typed-cone form, exhaustive moving ledgers, and optimized scalar trace budgets. Operator-theoretic realization over trace-class operators is an open extension, as is a derivation of the AM–GM step inside a typed real-arithmetic structure. The development is formalized in Lean as a mathlib-free mechanization at the typed positive-cone level (Appendix ). Cross-substrate generalizations such as CPT symmetry, gauge invariance, quantum self-adjointness, and function-field RH are presented as structural predictions, not theorems; the paper develops the abstract apparatus layer and names the hypotheses any substrate-specific application must supply.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Many obstruction arguments exhibit a localized failure mode that appears irreducible at the layer where it is first visible; this paper studies one audited route by which such needle obstructions cease to be obstructions, namely passage to a higher layer where additional admissible dissolving probes are available. The framework is the formed-layer membrane setting: zero-energy directions are removed by a legal quotient, native probes are assigned a quadratic native currency, unexplained dissolving currency is measured by an adequacy residual, and predictive membranes, dissolving transport records, and the all-six taxonomy control the transfer. The layer-dissolving endpoint theorem shows that, under predictive native bounds, residual bounds, and transport hypotheses, the dissolving currency is bounded uniformly across accepted stages, so no layer-dissolving predictive needles exist within the declared scope. The complementary duality-confinement membrane theorem shows that, under a separating anti-invariant readout and a vanishing-trace sequence of domination records, visible object mass is confined to the fixed locus of the involution. These are framework-bound dissolution results, not a universal singularity-elimination theorem or a claim about any named external problem. The adequacy-residual calculus on which the layer-dissolving endpoint depends is developed in .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Given two probe families on the same finite-dimensional carrier, this paper asks what a dissolving family D measures beyond what a native family L can explain under an audit energy C . Under the standing legal-energy quotient and null-mode legality hypotheses, the adequacy residual _C(D L) is the Schur-complement leftover built from the block currencies K_ LL , K_ DD , K_ DL , and K_ LD . We develop this residual as a calculus: the projection identity identifies it with T_D(I-P_L)T_D^* in energy-scaled coordinates; optimality and exact adequacy characterize Loewner minimality and zero residual; promotion combines native and residual budgets into a dissolving budget; and chain-rule, data-processing, and transfer laws describe native extension, post-processing, coarsening, and exact or defective bridges. The blind-spot witness theorem turns failure of a declared residual budget into an explicit recombination vector with positive excess. The paper does not claim exact adequacy generically, does not classify all probe-family pairs, and does not claim novelty for the classical operator-theoretic constructions it packages. A layer-dissolving use of the calculus is given in .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: [topsep=2pt,itemsep=1pt] P1: admissible only when the candidate cluster carries a selected update, a quotient or relation record, and a witness of descent compatibility, descent obstruction, or update-vs-quotient mismatch. Generic semantics, generic predicate meaning, generic selection criteria, and generic agency are not admissible as P1 projections in the absence of such a witness. P2: admissible only when the candidate carries a macro specification, a realization relation, specification-satisfaction data, and evidence of representability or non-representability. Macro-level predicates or objectives count only insofar as they are treated as content to be represented. Mere quotient equality, arbitrary relations without representability structure, and empirical observations without level and threshold data are not admissible as P2 projections. P3: admissible only when the candidate carries enriched route grammar, generated same-source, same-target route terms, and route-comparison data with a non-reducibility or coherence-mismatch certificate. Generic transitions, generic causal arrows, generic path records, and route undefinedness arising from P1 obstruction are not admissible as P3 projections unless the route/coherence threshold is explicitly present and the route comparison is specifically of the P3 type. P4: admissible only when the candidate carries a stage, order, transition, refinement, staged-dynamics, or regime-ordering record with laws beyond bare labels. Bare labels, arbitrary relations without order, transition, or refinement law, quotient packaging, and audit bookkeeping are not admissible as P4 projections. resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We present a math-only framework in which theories arise as fixed points of idempotent operators and open-endedness requires changing the operator rather than iterating it. Under minimal hypotheses of composability plus limited interface access with bounded observation, we show that the operator vocabulary P1–P6 arises canonically as unavoidable closure mechanics (Theorem ). Order-theoretic closure operators and dynamics-induced endomaps E_ ,f (built from a Markov kernel, a coarse-graining lens, and a timescale) are treated uniformly via the abstraction of idempotent endomaps and their fixed points. We define a computable total-variation idempotence defect for E_ ,f and show that small retention error implies approximate idempotence, yielding robust packaged “objects” at a given time-scale within a fixed lens/theory. To prevent spurious directionality, we define arrow-of-time as path-space KL divergence and prove that coarse-graining cannot increase it (data processing); we further formalize the protocol-trap principle showing that autonomous protocol holonomy does not generate sustained asymmetry unless a genuine affinity is present in the lifted dynamics. Finally, we give a finite forcing-style counting lemma: definable predicates are exponentially rare relative to a partition-based theory, so generic predicate extensions are overwhelmingly non-definable, providing a mathematically clean anti-saturation mechanism for strict ladder climbing.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The anti-relabeling ledger is part of the result. This paper does not claim the predictive-state or causal-state quotient construction as new; that is a standard way to summarize a process by its predictive consequences . It does not claim the closure-deficit identity, or the optimality of the best autonomous macro-predictor, as new; those are imported from the closure-deficit and no-go accounts . It does not claim the strict-extension, saturation, or promotion-obligation framework as new; those are imported standards for recognizing when a higher vocabulary is a genuine layer rather than a relabeling . Nor does it claim as new the game-theoretic fact that added structure matters. Folk theorems show that repeated interaction can support many outcomes; global games show how noisy private information can select; reputation models show how type structure changes play; evolutionary and stochastic-stability models show that convention selection can be a property of a run; correlated equilibrium and type spaces show how signals and hidden state enlarge the game . These are reference points the paper uses, not results it rebrands. The contribution is the conjunction, on one explicit repeated-game object, under one evidentiary discipline. First, the paper installs the predictive state as the canonical institution of repeated play and verifies, on the finite carrier, that it is not definable from the game's own stage vocabulary: the institutional partition strictly refines the stage partition and does not factor through it. Second, the paper prices the omission exactly by closure deficit, with a gap–residual decomposition that separates what conditioning on the institution recovers from what remains unpredictable even after that conditioning. Third, it assembles these facts into a certified strict-extension object: the institutional vocabulary saturates, admits an active label-feedback exhibit under a declared extension, and passes the admissibility gates for a promoted layer on the carrier. Fourth, the picture is subjected to tests that could have failed silently but were reported in full: the run-layer constants are reproducible within protocol yet fail three frozen out-of-sample transfer attempts, and the human-data analysis confirms the predictive-residue hypothesis while reversing the proposed timing bridge. The registered negatives are not qualifications to the result; they are part of the evidence for the strict-extension reading.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Formal theories of consciousness are difficult to compare, and difficult to trust, partly because three different kinds of claim routinely travel in one sentence: mathematical claims about a formal structure, empirical claims about how that structure meets observation, and ontological claims about what the structure's satisfaction would be. The field has begun to treat this as a foundational problem rather than a stylistic one. General frameworks for mathematical models of consciousness ask what a model must declare before it says anything ; formal work on testability shows that inference procedures and prediction data can interact so badly that a theory becomes unfalsifiable or trivially falsified ; and large adversarial collaborations have demonstrated how much machinery is needed to test even two well-resourced theories against each other, without producing a definitive verdict . Landscape reviews count theory families by the dozen . In such a field, a paper's first obligation is to say exactly what kind of claim each of its sentences makes. This paper takes that obligation as its organizing principle. It presents an architecture for consciousness built from standard finite mathematics: finite carriers, lenses, quotients, refinements, closure operators, viability kernels, and audited promotion between description layers. Around that architecture it assembles a catalog of exact finite results, a small set of machine-checked kernels, and one explicitly priced ontological bridge. Every scientific sentence in the paper is assigned to one of four claim lanes, defined in Section : structural results [S] (theorems and exact finite constructions), recognition bridges [R] (proposed interpretive mappings, never derivations), ontological implications [O] (conditional on named postulates), and open targets [OPEN] . The lane discipline is not decoration; it is enforced by a sentence-level claim ledger in the artifact, and the paper's central negative rule is that no amount of [S] material ever implies an [O] conclusion without the named purchases.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We propose that to be real is to have closed: that reality is not a substance, a substrate, or a set, but a ledger of survived closures. A thing is real when it is a package that earned its objecthood through audited gates and pays, continuously, to keep it. The proposal is grounded in the Six Birds corpus, which has spent the last years doing something Nietzsche predicted and no one else has attempted: worshipping the stone. The corpus constructs geometry, logic, time, probability, objects, events, agents, institutions, and selves from bare substrates, under explicit audit, with every failure banked and every success priced. The method of this paper is an itemized metaphysics. Every claim is either free, a theorem of the corpus at its stated grade, or purchased, spending one of two named axioms: Ontic Closure Completeness and Substrate Indifference. On this basis we argue that the Born rule's shape is the generic fate of compressed record layers, so that probability is born at the lens; that a simulation which passes a closure's gates is not a simulation of the thing but an instance of it, which is why lattice QCD computes the true proton; that ``matter'' and ``information'' are altitude labels, so that an economy is literally a ghost made of people; that mathematics is closure engineering in vitro, the design of lawful theory extensions ahead of any run, and in practice a map that unfolds only where someone walks; that the explanatory gap of consciousness is a non-descent certificate, predicted rather than embarrassing; that life and intelligence are graded, auditable positions on real axes rather than binaries; that a civilization which learns this grammar crosses into the era of meta-emergence, where creation itself is a wielded power, and that peace is a closure state, an achievement that strengthens rather than dissolves the identities it comprises; and that the great paradoxes (sorites, Theseus, Zeno, Mary's room, the unreasonable effectiveness of mathematics, the arrow of time) dissolve under ledger discipline, most of them because they demanded of a layer a certificate that no layer can issue. We close eight old problems and open eight new ones. The last sacrifice is Sacrifice itself.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: A certificate, in the sense used here, is a finite package of obligations and evidence. It is meant to prevent a higher-level object from being accepted merely because it has been renamed. The imported strict-extension framework specifies the obligations for certifying that a higher vocabulary is a genuine strict extension of a lower one . For the repeated-game setting, the relevant obligations are: a closed base law for the lower layer, meaning the best autonomous predictor available in the stage vocabulary; saturation of the higher vocabulary, meaning a predictive refinement fixed point; non-factorization, witnessed by split pairs whose distinctions are not definable from below; an exact quantitative price for omitting the higher layer, given by positive closure deficit and the gap–residual decomposition; material forcing, when a declared extension lets the higher layer feed back into play; and admissibility of the promoted object, checked by the gate battery described in . [Strict-extension certificate on the declared carrier] On the declared finite carrier, the canonical institutional state M=P_ is a certified strict extension of the stage game. The closed base law and exact price are supplied by ; non-factorization is supplied by ; saturation is supplied by ; material forcing is supplied, relative to its declared label-feedback extension, by ; and admissibility is supplied by the promotion certificate .

Nothing licenses transfer to large, noisy, or continuous systems beyond the displayed conditional schemas. No empirical content. No dataset, no parameter fit, no validation, no phenomenon rows (Section ). Provenance of predictions. The artifact contains documents labelled as predictions, but their initial Git history does not establish temporal precedence over implementations, and later corrections are versioned. Nothing in this paper calls them preregistered. Selected mechanization. Lean coverage is selected, not catalog-wide: kernels prove core facts and pin many enumerated values as certified constants matching the Python computations (per-law boundaries in Table and Appendix ); the current manifest-level validator accepts a zero-row schema and is a known release blocker, so no manifest-audited coverage claim is made. Inherited trust base. The Lean development trusts vendored foundations modules and declared axioms from the companion corpus, cataloged in Appendix ; their opacity guards are inherited, not re-proved. T1's family boundary. The forcing theorem is exact on one carrier; the family schema's hypotheses (live non-definable phase, deadline relevance) are strong and not claimed common (Section ). The simplified/full schema relation is unproved in both directions, certificate soundness is assumed where used, A2 has no formal theorem, and T17-I, the integrated instance, is open (Section ). The artifact's ``external review request'' documents record an internal author-driven review loop; they are not independent peer review, and this preprint has not been peer reviewed.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Six Birds Theory has produced three landed Clay-class conditional closures: Navier–Stokes regularity, the Riemann Hypothesis, and P vs NP, each under the SB closure assumption of Foundations I. This paper does not re-prove those substrate results. It extracts their common meta-theoretic form for a reader who treats Six Birds as a typed framework for organizing attempted closures of open conjectures. The account has two complementary halves. The negative half, Foreclosure, studies a typed primary carrier, meaning an attempted proof construction whose type signature targets a designated conjecture, and proves that admissible carriers fall into a finite state space: non-target-equivalent, target-equivalent tautological, bridge-failed, or matrix-element-terminal. The positive half, Recognition-Mode Landing, gives a seven-stage route for trace-state-only substrates: instead of deriving the load-bearing source from framework primitives, it imports that source as named recognition under closure formation. The v5 refinement states the joint thesis: derivation routes remain subject to foreclosure, while recognition-mode landings are structurally distinct peer routes under the same closure assumption. A third part, the Calibration Family, provides the typed bookkeeping that makes this comparison uniform across substrates: calibrations, bridges-as-theorems, directed bridge types, coverage geometry, framework-type mismatch, and named functorial gates. Layer-instantiation examples appear throughout: the three substrate validation rows (NS, RH, and PvNP), a thirteen-entry calibration seed catalog of typed detectors, two named coverage holes, and three named functorial gates from the PvNP track. The formal catalog contains seventeen rows: three partial structural derivations, eight primary theorem-grade rows, and six primary obligation rows. The body gives the mathematical proofs or obligation analyses, while Lean serves as the mechanization companion and audit trail. The nine honest obligation axioms are recorded with opacity guards, so their assumptions are explicit rather than silently instantiated; the full validator chain cross-checks the inventory, manifest, and trust base. The scope is deliberately limited: BSD and Hodge are out of scope except as future work or prediction, and no substrate closure is strengthened here to a standard-ZFC unconditional claim.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We present a reproducible computational framework—with Lean 4 mechanized proofs and deterministic Python simulations—that recasts quantum measurement, contextuality, and the measurement problem using operational semantics drawn from Six Birds Theory (SBT), a closure-based emergence calculus. Standard presentations of quantum mechanics mix causal evolution with inferential state update, so ``collapse,'' contextuality, and Schr\"odinger's cat are often treated as physical discontinuities or as evidence for surplus ontology. We separate these roles explicitly: causal substrate dynamics are distinguished from packaging (an idempotent closure operation that stabilizes record-level objects via a chosen record algebra). Operationally, we define an SBT theory package (Z,T,f,Q_f,U_f,E_f, A ) , mechanize its quotient/closure/audit lemmas in Lean 4, and implement a reproducible suite of simulations spanning quantum and classical examples. Our results are comparative and controlled: (i) dephasing in a fixed record basis is an idempotent packaging map whose fixed points are exactly the diagonal (record-classical) states; (ii) route mismatch between evolution and packaging is approximately zero when the Hamiltonian is diagonal in the record basis, but nonzero for generic Hamiltonians or incompatible record bases; (iii) in a double-slit model, decreasing environment-record overlap continuously suppresses fringe visibility, while conditioning in a quantum eraser restores complementary fringes; (iv) in a system–apparatus–environment measurement model, the global state can remain near-pure while the packaged record state is a classical mixture, and packaging remains idempotent. This role separation localizes which distinctions are layer-relative and yields information-theoretic diagnostics for context dependence and record stability. We do not claim to derive the Born rule or resolve Bell's theorem; instead, we provide a structurally explicit reformulation supported by mechanization and reproducible demonstrations.

Operationally, we define an SBT theory package (Z,T,f,Q_f,U_f,E_f, A ) , mechanize its quotient/closure/audit lemmas in Lean 4, and implement a reproducible suite of simulations spanning quantum and classical examples. Our results are comparative and controlled: (i) dephasing in a fixed record basis is an idempotent packaging map whose fixed points are exactly the diagonal (record-classical) states; (ii) route mismatch between evolution and packaging is approximately zero when the Hamiltonian is diagonal in the record basis, but nonzero for generic Hamiltonians or incompatible record bases; (iii) in a double-slit model, decreasing environment-record overlap continuously suppresses fringe visibility, while conditioning in a quantum eraser restores complementary fringes; (iv) in a system–apparatus–environment measurement model, the global state can remain near-pure while the packaged record state is a classical mixture, and packaging remains idempotent. This role separation localizes which distinctions are layer-relative and yields information-theoretic diagnostics for context dependence and record stability. We do not claim to derive the Born rule or resolve Bell's theorem; instead, we provide a structurally explicit reformulation supported by mechanization and reproducible demonstrations.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Empirical cosmology infers late-time acceleration by fitting homogeneous FLRW models to data products that are, by construction, coarse-grained summaries of an inhomogeneous universe. This procedure makes it difficult to separate a fundamental component from a closure correction required by the coarse-graining itself. We apply Six Birds Theory (SBT) to treat cosmological modeling as a closure package consisting of a lens (specifying what is retained), a completion (specifying how discarded structure is filled in), and audits (testing whether the packaged macro description is dynamically coherent under evolution). Operationally, we implement a minimal computational API for lenses, completions, packaging operators, idempotence defects, and route mismatch, together with provenance-tracked run bundles and PPD-style cross-probe audits. In calibrated toy systems, route mismatch is (numerically) zero in a linear control regime and becomes strictly positive when nonlinearity is turned on; in a patch-expansion proxy, a homogeneous-control case yields Q(t) 0 , whereas heterogeneous initial conditions produce a positive acceleration proxy ( Q_ peak 1.74 ) and a_ D >0 for 99% of late-time samples. Using synthetic distance–redshift data from a null- heterogeneous generator, homogeneous CDM fitting recovers _ 0.60 , and a heterogeneity-proxy rewrite term matches CDM fit quality and improves held-out prediction of a heterogeneity proxy by 100 in RMSE. On public DES SN5YR and DES Y6 BAO releases we demonstrate the same provenance and audit pipeline. These results motivate framing ``dark energy'' as an audit-driven rewrite hypothesis with staging and probe-split tests rather than a default new fluid. We are explicit that a fundamental cosmological constant is not ruled out here; current background probes prefer an approximately constant correction over the sampled redshift range and our LSS demonstrations are protocol-level under a surrogate backend pending physical 3 2pt likelihoods.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Every lawful current observable in E^ ! _ Q , acting on the saturated SAT layer T^ ! _ SAT , passes the following seven gate checks with the typed evidence records carried in its lawfulness data. G_ 1 , no SAT oracle smuggling. The check predicate says that the observable does not invoke an oracle for the SAT decision predicate. The status passes by construction: the audited shell admits ordinary deterministic polynomial-time transducers, not SAT-oracle machines. The evidence is the audit ledger recording the absence of oracle commitments. The implication is that the observable's computation does not implicitly use the SAT bit as input. G_ 2 , no witness oracle smuggling. The check predicate says that the observable does not invoke an oracle for a satisfying-witness producer . The status passes by construction, and the evidence is again the audit ledger of the admitted transducer. The implication is that satisfying assignments are not pre-loaded into the observable or made available as hidden input. G_ 3 , no external verifier oracle smuggling. The check predicate says that the observable does not invoke an external NP-verifier oracle. The status passes by the same audit evidence: verifier behavior must be realized by the declared polynomial-time computation itself. The implication is that the observable cannot test whether an assignment satisfies a formula by an undeclared oracle call. G_ 4 , no hidden B -bit smuggling. The check predicate says that the visibility lens does not encode a hidden bit, such as a disguised SAT bit, into the Q -visible package data . The status passes by visibility bookkeeping. The evidence is the visibility-lens record attached to the current instrument. The implication is that the Q -visible projection does not encode predictive or witness-side data. G_ 5 , no time-certificate smuggling. The check predicate says that the polynomial time certificate is honest: the observable does not exceed its declared polynomial budget by hiding deferred evaluation or unrecorded subcomputation. The status passes by the time-certificate clause of the lawfulness discipline. The evidence is the certificate itself, together with the replay record. The implication is that the observable's polynomial budget is the budget actually audited. G_ 6 , no scope violation. The check predicate says that the observable's domain is the all-input replay convention's instance set, not a favorable subfamily of SAT instances. The status passes by the all-input replay convention. The evidence is the replay record. The implication is that the observable cannot be a partial decider presented as a total current observable. G_ 7 , no overreading suppression. The check predicate says that the observable does not suppress overreading of its own audit data: the lawfulness record is faithful to the actual computation being audited. The status passes by the Foundations-III no-overreading-suppression theorem . The evidence is the audit witness field. The implication is that the audit ledger's records cannot be falsified or selectively hidden at audit time.

Under the frozen, layer-agnostic structural calculus of the Six Birds program, the dark-energy cluster instead supports a demarcation, a shape its genre laws assign before any computation: the problem factors into a thin forced skeleton, computed windows and audits, and a provably contingent residue. In a controlled finite carrier, the constant-slot term is recognized as the shadow price of a binding global closure budget — the cosmological instance of the law whose gravitational instance is Ryu–Takayanagi. Its value, by contrast, carries no in-layer law: a background sweep leaves a degenerate admissible set while the same audit constrains a control coupling, so the blindness is a property of the quantity — 's value classifies with the Standard Model's generation count, an observed input. A -free record-stability predicate confines the -analog to a strict two-sided window, and the coincidence problem reduces to a single question: whether the physical prior over the -modulus is non-singular near zero. On DESI DR2, Pantheon+, and compressed Planck, pre-registered audits return a constant-compatible null — the account of why CDM works — exhibit the phantom crossing as a chart artifact on one expansion history, and fire on the known supernova-versus-BAO tension. A fundamental is not refuted and its value is not derived; the demarcation proves the latter to be the character of the quantity, not unfinished business.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The structural laws of the Six Birds corpus through Foundations IV are stated from the standpoint of an external theorist: the theorist declares a lens, detects an obstruction, installs a repair, prices a residual, and runs the audit. This paper makes the closure apparatus part of the carrier. An endogenous closure system carries its own instruments, ledgers, repair generator, boundary records, and re-audit loop, and its claims of self-repair are admitted only when the relevant records are produced by its own transitions under a closed-loop source policy. Six definitions (D1–D6) and sixteen laws (E1–E16) give the resulting catalog: endogenous repair, bounded reflexivity, self-maintenance, repair compilation and collapse; priced exposure, alarm, control prices, and probe acquisition; stack rewrite, individuation, and repair transport; and reconsolidation, offline reclosure, and adaptability. The laws are carrier-side and substrate-independent. Living, cognitive, and social systems therefore enter on equal terms: physiological regulation and organismal maintenance, agent-side learning and control, and institutional reproduction and rewrite are distinct realizations of the same typed hypotheses, not metaphors for one another. Each law is stated in the six-part normal form inherited from Foundations IV, with an obstruction or falsifier, an exactly-one status partition where applicable, a proof spine, interaction discipline, and explicit nonclaims. D1–D6 and the core E1–E16 laws are represented in the companion Lean 4 development and finite Repair-World/law-specific campaign; two named interpretive corollaries, Alarm Fatigue and Operational Selfhood, remain unformalized and are marked accordingly. The finite campaign contains 348 preregistered comparisons across fifteen law-specific result artifacts, all passing. Existing particle and neural substrate experiments supply life-facing null, drive, maintenance, motif, and intervention evidence under explicit nonclaims, while an unrun planarian-regeneration protocol states a concrete biological promotion target and its falsifiers. No definition of biological life, consciousness, death, welfare, or autonomous evolution is claimed.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Confluence is usually read as order-independence of reduction, while flatness is usually read as path-independence of transport. This paper argues that their local cores coincide once rewriting is equipped with its missing two-dimensional cells. The relevant object is not the bare reduction graph but a reduction 2-complex whose 0 -cells are states, whose 1 -cells are one-step rewrites, and whose generating 2 -cells are local peaks or, in structured rewriting settings, reachable critical pairs. In that setting, elementary flatness is exactly local confluence. We prove this core equivalence and record the supporting fact that confluence plus normalization yields a unique normal form from a chosen start state. We then show computationally that the corrected local/global picture survives exhaustive finite-ARS stress tests in the terminating regime, curated string-rewriting examples, and a curated left-linear term-rewriting bridge with genuine nonroot overlap. These experiments also show that bare graph-flatness surrogates fail, while reachable critical-pair defects align with the observed local obstruction layer. Finally, explicit before/after examples show that completion can be read as holonomy elimination: the local generator persists while its defect disappears. The full finite terminating left-linear TRS theorem package remains to be written in full generality, but the correct object, local generators, and evidence boundary are now fixed.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: When must an operator-valued obstruction associated with an involutive system vanish? This paper answers that question inside the Six Birds framework by naming Self-Dual Trace Confinement (SDTC) as the recognition source for formed closures with genuine involutive self-duality. The mechanism is the duality-confinement membrane theorem: for an involutive object ledger with separating anti-invariant readout, a sequence of positive domination records B_n with B_n 0 forces the anti-invariant ledger to vanish and confines visible mass to the fixed locus of the duality. The supporting apparatus develops the involutive object ledger, the anti-invariant ledger and trace identity, direct qualitative and quantitative confinement, completed-domination bridges, Douglas factorization in typed-cone form, exhaustive moving ledgers, and optimized scalar trace budgets. Operator-theoretic realization over trace-class operators is an open extension, as is a derivation of the AM–GM step inside a typed real-arithmetic structure. The development is formalized in Lean as a mathlib-free mechanization at the typed positive-cone level (Appendix ). Cross-substrate generalizations such as CPT symmetry, gauge invariance, quantum self-adjointness, and function-field RH are presented as structural predictions, not theorems; the paper develops the abstract apparatus layer and names the hypotheses any substrate-specific application must supply.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We present a reproducible computational framework for defining and measuring agency in finite controlled Markov kernels without assuming goals, utilities, or homunculi. The framework operationalizes three complementary metrics: (i) viability kernels (greatest controlled-invariant safe sets under ledger-gated feasibility and successor-support semantics), (ii) feasible empowerment (channel capacity of the induced action-to-output channel restricted by budgets), and (iii) an empirical packaging endomap whose idempotence defect quantifies objecthood for coarse lenses. Building on Six Birds Theory (SBT, ), we propose that an agent is a theory object—a maintained package inside an induced layer with a ledger-gated interface—and we separate agenthood (enablement: the layer exists and persists) from agency (causation: interface interventions change outside futures). Throughout, ``theory'' is used in the SBT technical sense—a closure (lens + completion + audit)—not as a speculative hypothesis or manuscript-type category. Across matched-control ablations in a minimal ring-world substrate, we obtain four auditable separations: (1) calibrated null regimes prevent false positives (single-action: 0-bit empowerment; schedule trap: 1 bit under the wrong model, 0 under the correct one); (2) enabling repair collapses idempotence defect at =2 from 1 to 0; (3) enabling protocol holonomy leaves H=1 unchanged but increases empowerment for H 2 ; and (4) operator rewriting (skill ) monotonically increases median empowerment ( 0.73 1.34 bits). resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.

hypotheses.text: The following substrate features are necessary (up to equivalent internal encodings) to realize the corresponding primitives without smuggling: [leftmargin=*, itemsep=0.35em] Autonomy requires phase-in-state (P3). If a substrate permits staged protocols but does not represent protocol state internally, then stroboscopic composition can produce apparent arrows of time that vanish once the dynamics is made autonomous by lifting state. Therefore, any autonomous semantics for protocols must encode phase-in-state (or an equivalent internal mechanism). Genuine arrows require internal drive (P6 drive ). Autonomy plus staging does not imply directionality. In an autonomous lifted model with reversible internal phase dynamics, protocol-induced arrows can disappear ( Sigma_T 0 ). To obtain a genuine arrow in an autonomous substrate, one needs internal drive detectable by a nonzero affinity class (ACC cycle integrals). Audits must be monotone under coarse-graining (P6). There exist processes with real micro irreversibility but macro observations whose path law is reversal-invariant ( Sigma_T^ macro =0 ). Any audit that reports increased directionality after coarse-graining violates limited-access semantics and is therefore smuggled. Packaging must be an internal (approximate) idempotent endomap (P5). Without an internal endomap e (or closure operator) that induces packaging equivalence x _e y iff e(x)=e(y) , there is no internal notion of ``same packaged object'' and no internal fixed-point criterion for stability. Declaring macrostates by fiat is smuggling. Route mismatch is distinct from directionality (P3 vs.\ P6). Packaging along different refinement routes can yield a measurable holonomy defect (route mismatch), even when directionality audits obey data processing

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Across disciplines, stable descriptive layers rely on small sets of variables that budget feasibility, accumulate along protocols, or appear as exchange rates between incompatible objectives. We call such variables currencies. This paper gives a layer-relative definition of currency within the Six Birds closure calculus and proposes a currency–constraint principle: lower-layer currencies become higher-layer constraints because packaged higher-level objects can persist only under bounded lower-layer spending, while higher-layer currencies emerge as the shadow prices of those budgets. In finite Markov laboratories this principle becomes measurable. Path-reversal asymmetry and cycle affinities furnish lower-layer audits; constrained maximum-entropy closure yields dual prices; and across a resolution ladder we observe five robust signatures: honest coarse-grained directionality, monotone price emergence with a slack regime, growth of currency dimension with resolution, failure of proxy currencies under prediction and dual stability, and improved packaging coherence under stronger budget enforcement. A Lean formalization proves deterministic-pushforward monotonicity for a finite KL form, providing a formal anchor for the audit side of the story. The result is a practical and conceptual account of why temperatures, prices, regularizers, and attention weights recur across sciences as the same mathematical kind of object.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: This paper isolates a control-stable intrinsic family inside the fixed-support recombination layer of Six Birds theory. The first three papers of the series established admissible event packages on fixed support, predictive quotients on single histories, and the branchwise and recombination quotients on branch assemblages. Here we identify a two-anchor relative-cycle family in which branchwise predictive agreement does not determine later recombination observables. We instantiate the standard factorized no-interference collapse on the flagship surface, exhibit exact-finite separation for two flagship anchors, and formalize a concrete Lean witness kernel for the reference-positive anchor, including a no-factorization corollary. We separate the flagship positives from classical mixture, hidden predictive memory, protocol artifact, and boundary-collapse or completion-sensitive negatives using an explicit matched control bundle. We also show that nearby exact positives exist within the same relative-cycle family, while the erasure side remains empirical support rather than formal core.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: This appendix collects the formal definitions and theorem statements used in the main text. At the level of general mathematical form, the quotient and factorization language used here sits near behavioral equivalence, bisimulation, exact aggregation, and standard quotient-factorization arguments . It does not reproduce proofs. The comparison base is inherited from the first three papers of the series: fixed support and admissibility, the current and predictive quotients on single histories, and the branchwise and recombination quotients on branch assemblages. The present paper uses those inherited structures only to define and compare the flagship recombination family on a common exact-finite support. At the single-history level, the current quotient Q_i identifies reachable histories that are indistinguishable by the current event package, while the predictive quotient M_i identifies histories that remain indistinguishable under all admissible future generator/observable words on the reachable image. At the branch-assemblage level, the branchwise quotient K_i identifies assemblages with the same weighted multiset of predictive classes, while the recombination quotient R_i identifies assemblages that are indistinguishable by admissible later recombination observables. When recombination equivalence refines branchwise equivalence there is a canonical forgetful map _i : R_i → K_i .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We study recombination-sensitive branch structure on a fixed-support substrate in Six Birds Theory. Building on prior work on event packaging and predictive holonomy, we introduce branch assemblages and two quotient levels at an interface: a branchwise predictive quotient ( K_i ), which captures independent predictive treatment of the branches, and a recombination quotient ( R_i ), which captures admissible recombination observables on branch families. On this architecture we exhibit a benchmark suite separating classical mixture, hidden predictive memory without recombination sensitivity, route-marked suppression, erasure-conditioned recovery, cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. A supporting theorem layer proves the abstract factorized no-interference regime and its obstruction by strict refinement, and one promoted positive family is connected to a theorem-backed concrete witness in an aligned Lean model. We do not claim a general reconstruction of non-Hilbert interference or a formalization of the full benchmark runtime. The claim is narrower: these recombination phenomena arise on fixed support, can be audited exactly, and admit a partial formal backbone on the Six Birds substrate.

Foundations IV is not a foundational reset of Foundations I/II/III, not a unification claim about the eight axes, and not an exhaustive catalog.
