resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Foundations IV is a catalog of layer-agnostic structural laws built on the Foundations I/II/III apparatus. Its organizing question is what must be true, before choosing a substrate—whether analysis, arithmetic, physics, biology, chemistry, economics and finance, linguistics, cognitive and social science, or computation—for a layer to have lawful access, stable records, transport, symmetry, closure, and limits. The contribution is a uniform normal-form template applied across 52 laws; each row states its setup, theorem, proof spine, case structure, interaction status, and nonclaims, so recurring obstructions such as failed descent, hidden predictive structure, local-global failure, and record nonclosure can be compared in one register. The formalization status is explicit: the catalog contains 46 direct Lean theorems, 2 substrate-delegated anchors (No-Needles Stability and Closure–Reality Boundary), 2 partial wrappers (Hiddenness and Duality Fixity), and 2 obligation wrappers (CSL Formed-Closure and Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking); the four trust-base axioms used by the wrappers are disclosed through an opacity-guard pattern, each guarded by an opaque source predicate that prevents the axiom from being instantiated without the corresponding substrate or future-source certificate. Foundations IV is not a foundational reset of Foundations I/II/III, not a unification claim about the eight axes, and not an exhaustive catalog.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We present a reproducible computational framework for defining and measuring agency in finite controlled Markov kernels without assuming goals, utilities, or homunculi. The framework operationalizes three complementary metrics: (i) viability kernels (greatest controlled-invariant safe sets under ledger-gated feasibility and successor-support semantics), (ii) feasible empowerment (channel capacity of the induced action-to-output channel restricted by budgets), and (iii) an empirical packaging endomap whose idempotence defect quantifies objecthood for coarse lenses. Building on Six Birds Theory (SBT, ), we propose that an agent is a theory object—a maintained package inside an induced layer with a ledger-gated interface—and we separate agenthood (enablement: the layer exists and persists) from agency (causation: interface interventions change outside futures). Throughout, ``theory'' is used in the SBT technical sense—a closure (lens + completion + audit)—not as a speculative hypothesis or manuscript-type category. Across matched-control ablations in a minimal ring-world substrate, we obtain four auditable separations: (1) calibrated null regimes prevent false positives (single-action: 0-bit empowerment; schedule trap: 1 bit under the wrong model, 0 under the correct one); (2) enabling repair collapses idempotence defect at =2 from 1 to 0; (3) enabling protocol holonomy leaves H=1 unchanged but increases empowerment for H 2 ; and (4) operator rewriting (skill ) monotonically increases median empowerment ( 0.73 1.34 bits). All experiments are driven by deterministic, hash-traceable scripts with a strict audit mode, and a Lean 4 anchor formalizes the viability-kernel fixed-point property. We are explicit that stronger claims about goals, consciousness, or real organisms are not established here; our conclusions rely on finite witnesses and operational proxies under explicit controls.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Randomness is often treated as either ontic indeterminacy or epistemic ignorance. We develop a third, operational account within Six Birds: layer-relative randomness is the predictive residue of non-closure under a chosen packaging and budget. For a micro process X_t and a packaging : X Y , we define the micro-closure deficit at scale by CD_ ( )=I(X_t; Y_ t+ Y_t) , the information about the next packaged state that remains hidden inside the current macro-object. This yields the exact decomposition H(Y_ t+ Y_t)=H(Y_ t+ X_t)+CD_ ( ) , separating intrinsic substrate uncertainty from randomness introduced by discarded distinctions. We connect this exact quantity to computable diagnostics native to earlier Six Birds work, including route mismatch for coarse-grained Markov dynamics and predictive log-loss gaps under limited-memory models. In controlled Markov benchmarks, closure deficit vanishes on exactly lumpable partitions and rises with within-fiber heterogeneity, while route mismatch tracks it closely. In budgeted prediction, increasing memory order buys back hidden distinctions and lowers held-out log loss. In toy hashing, one-wayness and random-lookingness emerge as the same packaging-and-budget phenomenon: high-entropy inputs obey q/2^n inversion scaling, while low-entropy inputs collapse the effect. The result is a measurable account of randomness that unifies coarse-graining, limited prediction, and feasible one-wayness without treating randomness as primitive.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The Six Birds corpus through certifies states: each of its laws fixes a single map, quotient, package, or declared finite family and proves a static classification about it. Nothing in the corpus certifies runs — liveness (every orbit eventually earns a certificate), amortized or transfinite cost over unbounded time, covers that must move with their targets, obstructions that grow, react, or are manufactured by the system's own history, route defects that integrate into potentials, transport that emerges from substrate dynamics, or content that persists through repeated loss. This paper is the catalog of exactly those laws: dynamical structural laws (G1–G13), organized in clusters, each stated in the six-part normal form inherited verbatim from and each carrying a temporal quantifier that no static row possesses. The laws were mined from eccentric mathematical problems — Collatz, Goodstein, Egyptian fractions, reverse-and-add, Recam\'an, the angel problem, sandpiles, rule 184, Ducci, aperiodic tilings, Hadwiger–Nelson, Apollonian packings — treated as theorem detectors: each problem's folklore almost-proof names a promoted object, the object's lawful descended certificate fixes a boundary expression, and the residual surviving comparison against every existing law is the law seed. All thirteen laws are mechanized in Mathlib-free Lean 4 with per-declaration kernel-axiom audits; six laws are full theorem-grade rows and one splits into an unconditional theorem and a schema, four are schema-grade with named boxed hypotheses, and three are calibration-anchored schemas discharged end-to-end by solved classical instances. The paper solves no open problem and claims none: Collatz, Erd o s–Straus, Lychrel, Recam\'an, the Langton's-ant highway, Gilbreath, and the exact chromatic number of the plane all remain open, and each law's nonclaims say so explicitly.

The complementary question is what it costs to buy the missing distinctions back once the current package has already failed to stabilize them. To expose that accounting side directly, we fix the strongest hidden-type benchmark and measure the budgeted randomness curve Rand_B empirically using packaged predictors of increasing memory order. The empirical curve is reported in the feasible-class sense of : at budget B=L , we plot the best held-out log loss available among predictors of order at most L . resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We study recombination-sensitive branch structure on a fixed-support substrate in Six Birds Theory. Building on prior work on event packaging and predictive holonomy, we introduce branch assemblages and two quotient levels at an interface: a branchwise predictive quotient ( K_i ), which captures independent predictive treatment of the branches, and a recombination quotient ( R_i ), which captures admissible recombination observables on branch families. On this architecture we exhibit a benchmark suite separating classical mixture, hidden predictive memory without recombination sensitivity, route-marked suppression, erasure-conditioned recovery, cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. A supporting theorem layer proves the abstract factorized no-interference regime and its obstruction by strict refinement, and one promoted positive family is connected to a theorem-backed concrete witness in an aligned Lean model. We do not claim a general reconstruction of non-Hilbert interference or a formalization of the full benchmark runtime. The claim is narrower: these recombination phenomena arise on fixed support, can be audited exactly, and admit a partial formal backbone on the Six Birds substrate.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: This appendix collects the formal definitions and theorem statements used in the main text. At the level of general mathematical form, the quotient and factorization language used here sits near behavioral equivalence, bisimulation, exact aggregation, and standard quotient-factorization arguments . It does not reproduce proofs. The comparison base is inherited from the first three papers of the series: fixed support and admissibility, the current and predictive quotients on single histories, and the branchwise and recombination quotients on branch assemblages. The present paper uses those inherited structures only to define and compare the flagship recombination family on a common exact-finite support. At the single-history level, the current quotient Q_i identifies reachable histories that are indistinguishable by the current event package, while the predictive quotient M_i identifies histories that remain indistinguishable under all admissible future generator/observable words on the reachable image. At the branch-assemblage level, the branchwise quotient K_i identifies assemblages with the same weighted multiset of predictive classes, while the recombination quotient R_i identifies assemblages that are indistinguishable by admissible later recombination observables. When recombination equivalence refines branchwise equivalence there is a canonical forgetful map _i : R_i → K_i .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The anti-relabeling ledger is part of the result. This paper does not claim the predictive-state or causal-state quotient construction as new; that is a standard way to summarize a process by its predictive consequences . It does not claim the closure-deficit identity, or the optimality of the best autonomous macro-predictor, as new; those are imported from the closure-deficit and no-go accounts . It does not claim the strict-extension, saturation, or promotion-obligation framework as new; those are imported standards for recognizing when a higher vocabulary is a genuine layer rather than a relabeling . Nor does it claim as new the game-theoretic fact that added structure matters. Folk theorems show that repeated interaction can support many outcomes; global games show how noisy private information can select; reputation models show how type structure changes play; evolutionary and stochastic-stability models show that convention selection can be a property of a run; correlated equilibrium and type spaces show how signals and hidden state enlarge the game . These are reference points the paper uses, not results it rebrands. The contribution is the conjunction, on one explicit repeated-game object, under one evidentiary discipline. First, the paper installs the predictive state as the canonical institution of repeated play and verifies, on the finite carrier, that it is not definable from the game's own stage vocabulary: the institutional partition strictly refines the stage partition and does not factor through it. Second, the paper prices the omission exactly by closure deficit, with a gap–residual decomposition that separates what conditioning on the institution recovers from what remains unpredictable even after that conditioning. Third, it assembles these facts into a certified strict-extension object: the institutional vocabulary saturates, admits an active label-feedback exhibit under a declared extension, and passes the admissibility gates for a promoted layer on the carrier. Fourth, the picture is subjected to tests that could have failed silently but were reported in full: the run-layer constants are reproducible within protocol yet fail three frozen out-of-sample transfer attempts, and the human-data analysis confirms the predictive-residue hypothesis while reversing the proposed timing bridge. The registered negatives are not qualifications to the result; they are part of the evidence for the strict-extension reading.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Formal theories of consciousness are difficult to compare, and difficult to trust, partly because three different kinds of claim routinely travel in one sentence: mathematical claims about a formal structure, empirical claims about how that structure meets observation, and ontological claims about what the structure's satisfaction would be. The field has begun to treat this as a foundational problem rather than a stylistic one. General frameworks for mathematical models of consciousness ask what a model must declare before it says anything ; formal work on testability shows that inference procedures and prediction data can interact so badly that a theory becomes unfalsifiable or trivially falsified ; and large adversarial collaborations have demonstrated how much machinery is needed to test even two well-resourced theories against each other, without producing a definitive verdict . Landscape reviews count theory families by the dozen . In such a field, a paper's first obligation is to say exactly what kind of claim each of its sentences makes. This paper takes that obligation as its organizing principle. It presents an architecture for consciousness built from standard finite mathematics: finite carriers, lenses, quotients, refinements, closure operators, viability kernels, and audited promotion between description layers. Around that architecture it assembles a catalog of exact finite results, a small set of machine-checked kernels, and one explicitly priced ontological bridge. Every scientific sentence in the paper is assigned to one of four claim lanes, defined in Section : structural results [S] (theorems and exact finite constructions), recognition bridges [R] (proposed interpretive mappings, never derivations), ontological implications [O] (conditional on named postulates), and open targets [OPEN] . The lane discipline is not decoration; it is enforced by a sentence-level claim ledger in the artifact, and the paper's central negative rule is that no amount of [S] material ever implies an [O] conclusion without the named purchases.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We propose that to be real is to have closed: that reality is not a substance, a substrate, or a set, but a ledger of survived closures. A thing is real when it is a package that earned its objecthood through audited gates and pays, continuously, to keep it. The proposal is grounded in the Six Birds corpus, which has spent the last years doing something Nietzsche predicted and no one else has attempted: worshipping the stone. The corpus constructs geometry, logic, time, probability, objects, events, agents, institutions, and selves from bare substrates, under explicit audit, with every failure banked and every success priced. The method of this paper is an itemized metaphysics. Every claim is either free, a theorem of the corpus at its stated grade, or purchased, spending one of two named axioms: Ontic Closure Completeness and Substrate Indifference. On this basis we argue that the Born rule's shape is the generic fate of compressed record layers, so that probability is born at the lens; that a simulation which passes a closure's gates is not a simulation of the thing but an instance of it, which is why lattice QCD computes the true proton; that ``matter'' and ``information'' are altitude labels, so that an economy is literally a ghost made of people; that mathematics is closure engineering in vitro, the design of lawful theory extensions ahead of any run, and in practice a map that unfolds only where someone walks; that the explanatory gap of consciousness is a non-descent certificate, predicted rather than embarrassing; that life and intelligence are graded, auditable positions on real axes rather than binaries; that a civilization which learns this grammar crosses into the era of meta-emergence, where creation itself is a wielded power, and that peace is a closure state, an achievement that strengthens rather than dissolves the identities it comprises; and that the great paradoxes (sorites, Theseus, Zeno, Mary's room, the unreasonable effectiveness of mathematics, the arrow of time) dissolve under ledger discipline, most of them because they demanded of a layer a certificate that no layer can issue. We close eight old problems and open eight new ones. The last sacrifice is Sacrifice itself.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The structural laws of the Six Birds corpus through Foundations IV are stated from the standpoint of an external theorist: the theorist declares a lens, detects an obstruction, installs a repair, prices a residual, and runs the audit. This paper makes the closure apparatus part of the carrier. An endogenous closure system carries its own instruments, ledgers, repair generator, boundary records, and re-audit loop, and its claims of self-repair are admitted only when the relevant records are produced by its own transitions under a closed-loop source policy. Six definitions (D1–D6) and sixteen laws (E1–E16) give the resulting catalog: endogenous repair, bounded reflexivity, self-maintenance, repair compilation and collapse; priced exposure, alarm, control prices, and probe acquisition; stack rewrite, individuation, and repair transport; and reconsolidation, offline reclosure, and adaptability. The laws are carrier-side and substrate-independent. Living, cognitive, and social systems therefore enter on equal terms: physiological regulation and organismal maintenance, agent-side learning and control, and institutional reproduction and rewrite are distinct realizations of the same typed hypotheses, not metaphors for one another. Each law is stated in the six-part normal form inherited from Foundations IV, with an obstruction or falsifier, an exactly-one status partition where applicable, a proof spine, interaction discipline, and explicit nonclaims. D1–D6 and the core E1–E16 laws are represented in the companion Lean 4 development and finite Repair-World/law-specific campaign; two named interpretive corollaries, Alarm Fatigue and Operational Selfhood, remain unformalized and are marked accordingly. The finite campaign contains 348 preregistered comparisons across fifteen law-specific result artifacts, all passing. Existing particle and neural substrate experiments supply life-facing null, drive, maintenance, motif, and intervention evidence under explicit nonclaims, while an unrun planarian-regeneration protocol states a concrete biological promotion target and its falsifiers. No definition of biological life, consciousness, death, welfare, or autonomous evolution is claimed.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The paper establishes a substrate-level result. On a fixed-support Six Birds architecture, branchwise predictive structure and recombination-sensitive structure can be separated operationally, and that separation can be audited under exact finite controls. The benchmark suite shows that the same substrate supports a classical-mixture null regime, hidden predictive memory without additional recombination sensitivity, readable-route suppression, erased conditional recovery, bounded cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. The formal contribution is narrower. The Lean development proves an abstract refinement layer under detectability, a factorized no-interference regime in which the recombination quotient collapses to the branchwise quotient, and the corresponding obstruction result that strict refinement rules out global branchwise factorization. It also proves one theorem-backed concrete positive instance for an aligned Lean model of the promoted family n5_d1_w1of4_3of4 . These results support the interpretation of the benchmark suite but do not replace it.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The anti-relabeling ledger is part of the result. This paper does not claim the predictive-state or causal-state quotient construction as new; that is a standard way to summarize a process by its predictive consequences . It does not claim the closure-deficit identity, or the optimality of the best autonomous macro-predictor, as new; those are imported from the closure-deficit and no-go accounts . It does not claim the strict-extension, saturation, or promotion-obligation framework as new; those are imported standards for recognizing when a higher vocabulary is a genuine layer rather than a relabeling . Nor does it claim as new the game-theoretic fact that added structure matters. Folk theorems show that repeated interaction can support many outcomes; global games show how noisy private information can select; reputation models show how type structure changes play; evolutionary and stochastic-stability models show that convention selection can be a property of a run; correlated equilibrium and type spaces show how signals and hidden state enlarge the game . These are reference points the paper uses, not results it rebrands. The contribution is the conjunction, on one explicit repeated-game object, under one evidentiary discipline. First, the paper installs the predictive state as the canonical institution of repeated play and verifies, on the finite carrier, that it is not definable from the game's own stage vocabulary: the institutional partition strictly refines the stage partition and does not factor through it. Second, the paper prices the omission exactly by closure deficit, with a gap–residual decomposition that separates what conditioning on the institution recovers from what remains unpredictable even after that conditioning. Third, it assembles these facts into a certified strict-extension object: the institutional vocabulary saturates, admits an active label-feedback exhibit under a declared extension, and passes the admissibility gates for a promoted layer on the carrier. Fourth, the picture is subjected to tests that could have failed silently but were reported in full: the run-layer constants are reproducible within protocol yet fail three frozen out-of-sample transfer attempts, and the human-data analysis confirms the predictive-residue hypothesis while reversing the proposed timing bridge. The registered negatives are not qualifications to the result; they are part of the evidence for the strict-extension reading.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: What makes a mathematical object useful when it does not live in the layer where the problem is posed? Imaginary numbers are not real, infinitesimals are not real scalars, roots of irreducible polynomials need not lie in the base field, and cohomology classes are not vertex potentials. This paper studies that pattern by separating a lower layer, where a problem and its accepted answers are stated, from a promoted layer, where additional objects may be available. We define theory layers, promotion bridges, audited descending expressions, and the Strict Audited Utility (SAU) certificate, and then show that SAU is extracted from strict useful traces rather than stipulated. The main results are a theorem stack: Essential Boundary Necessity (Theorem A), which forces hidden promoted support and an audited lower boundary; SAU Boundary Normal Form (Theorem B); a Partial Converse and Tautology Barrier (Theorem C); SAU Soundness (Theorem D); Basic Profile Classification (Theorem E); four canonical witnesses from imaginary numbers, dual numbers and first jets, Galois roots, and graph cohomology; Minimality and universal promotion (Theorem F); and a Profile Transfer theorem (Theorem G). Together they show that, in finite typed audited promoted-use traces, strict mathematical usefulness forces hidden non-descent plus audited boundary descent. The claim is deliberately scoped: the paper does not claim that all mathematics is useful, does not literalize hidden objects downstairs, and does not claim that the Lean development independently proves every paper theorem. The Lean material is a traceability harness, with substantive proof language reserved for direct, computational, and definitional proof rows.

This paper studies that pattern by separating a lower layer, where a problem and its accepted answers are stated, from a promoted layer, where additional objects may be available. We define theory layers, promotion bridges, audited descending expressions, and the Strict Audited Utility (SAU) certificate, and then show that SAU is extracted from strict useful traces rather than stipulated. The main results are a theorem stack: Essential Boundary Necessity (Theorem A), which forces hidden promoted support and an audited lower boundary; SAU Boundary Normal Form (Theorem B); a Partial Converse and Tautology Barrier (Theorem C); SAU Soundness (Theorem D); Basic Profile Classification (Theorem E); four canonical witnesses from imaginary numbers, dual numbers and first jets, Galois roots, and graph cohomology; Minimality and universal promotion (Theorem F); and a Profile Transfer theorem (Theorem G). Together they show that, in finite typed audited promoted-use traces, strict mathematical usefulness forces hidden non-descent plus audited boundary descent. The claim is deliberately scoped: the paper does not claim that all mathematics is useful, does not literalize hidden objects downstairs, and does not claim that the Lean development independently proves every paper theorem. The Lean material is a traceability harness, with substantive proof language reserved for direct, computational, and definitional proof rows.

A Lean structural kernel with modules and proof gaps records the formal companion discipline.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The preceding carrier-exactification paper established a scoped carrier layer on the Route A flagship support: a lawful same-branch witness, a non-faithful public signature shadow, a protocol-indexed carrier surface, scoped quadratic carrying, and two proto-event and proto-test pilots. We ask whether this carrier structure supports admissible event and test structure on fixed support. The central construct is an event bridge record B_E=(C,P,I,L,V, ,S,A) binding a carrier-side predicate, a public/readout-side predicate, an instrument, a selected lift or forgetting map, a visibility and suppression record, a threshold record, an exact-six role profile, and an audit record. A deterministic artifact pipeline generates candidate events, constructs bridge records, applies an admissibility gate, runs controls, scores layer placement, attempts finite test-family construction, and records the consequences for shared-event identity, proto-effect structure, quadratic alignment, and exact-six bookkeeping. From a pool of seventeen candidates, two inherited scoped positives — a quadratic level-set event and a transition-stability test — are accepted at the event gate and retained under controls as protocol-indexed event-level objects. No finite admissible test family is accepted: the one serious protocol-indexed bridge-family candidate is non-exhaustive because a required readout-agreement slot is unrealized. The scoped quadratic families organize the accepted q-levelset event boundary at event level but not at test level. The resulting classification is accepted scoped protocol-indexed event-level structure without accepted tests, shared-event identity, or proto-effect operations.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Earlier papers in the fixed-support line of Six Birds Theory established admissible event packages, predictive and recombination quotients, a control-stable Route A flagship corpus, promotion criteria, and the intrinsic promoted-package survivor. They left open the internal carrier status of that survivor. We introduce a carrier-level substrate on the same Route A flagship corpus, consisting of three state-like objects and one structural relation. The three objects are a lawful same-branch witness, a refined witness rung on which the same-branch transport and readout law exactifies; a coarse public signature shadow, which retains public signature role but not lawful transport; and a flagship-only protocol-indexed carrier surface, an autonomous lift of the witness on which protocol coordinates are first-class state data. The structural relation is non-faithful public compression: a projection from the witness to the public shadow that preserves public signature role but does not preserve the refined lawful structure. A seven-criterion exactification audit adapted from standard operational-theory methodology—readout sufficiency, transport and readout law, non-reducibility against the lower quotient baselines, section and protocol honesty, denominator and expansion stress, and cross-seed support—together with a refreshed section/protocol honesty rerun on the lifted flagship patch and a controlled adjacent-surface search stabilises the atlas. Three claim-bearing quadratic families and two proto-event/test families survive on the scoped carrier. Carrier law on the public surface, cross-seed carrier exactification, and full-core carrier exactification are not earned; those non-claims are preserved explicitly. A Lean formal layer records the criterion vocabulary and a typed mirror of the final verdict. The carrier atlas, with its scope and compression structure made explicit, is the substrate carried forward.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Formal incompleteness explains why no sufficiently expressive effective theory captures all arithmetic truth, but it does not by itself provide a structural language for comparing theory growth. This paper develops such a language by treating a formal theory as a packaged closure object evaluated on a frozen ledger. First, a fixed idempotent package saturates under iteration: repeated closure does not sustain persistent strict growth. Hence genuine growth requires package change. Second, on a frozen slice with fixed yield, cost, and support data, efficiency transfers across cone-equivalent representatives, yielding a restricted alignment theorem. Third, these internal results combine with an explicit external dependency contract to give a conditional arithmetic lift: if the required canonical-family-on-cone assumptions are discharged from the arithmetic literature, then frontier-efficient extension operators admit canonical representatives on the relevant comparison cone. The result reframes incompleteness and axiom choice in package language. G\"odel becomes the canonical fixed-package failure mode, while new axioms appear as controlled package changes evaluated under a frozen regime. Vendor-backed PICA evidence is used only to discipline primitive roles and scope, not as proof support.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Given two probe families on the same finite-dimensional carrier, this paper asks what a dissolving family D measures beyond what a native family L can explain under an audit energy C . Under the standing legal-energy quotient and null-mode legality hypotheses, the adequacy residual _C(D L) is the Schur-complement leftover built from the block currencies K_ LL , K_ DD , K_ DL , and K_ LD . We develop this residual as a calculus: the projection identity identifies it with T_D(I-P_L)T_D^* in energy-scaled coordinates; optimality and exact adequacy characterize Loewner minimality and zero residual; promotion combines native and residual budgets into a dissolving budget; and chain-rule, data-processing, and transfer laws describe native extension, post-processing, coarsening, and exact or defective bridges. The blind-spot witness theorem turns failure of a declared residual budget into an explicit recombination vector with positive excess. The paper does not claim exact adequacy generically, does not classify all probe-family pairs, and does not claim novelty for the classical operator-theoretic constructions it packages. A layer-dissolving use of the calculus is given in .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Earlier work in the Six-Bird program supplies six primitive role families ( P_1, ,P_6 — descent, representability, route mismatch, refinement, packaging, audit), an admissibility and exact-six scope discipline over FATCD , inherited status, threshold, visibility, and audit machinery, and concrete model fragments such as PICA and Cantor. It does not, however, supply a paper-level finite interaction calculus that records, in one finite typed framework, how the six primitive roles interact, how typed directed cells are judged, how defects induce statuses, how promotion is audited, and how model realizations are scoped. This paper constructs , a finite audited typed calculus for six-bird interaction. The calculus carries finite typed schemas of theory packages, instruments, visibility and suppression records, witness and update families, role-channel, directed-cell, pair-observable, promotion, dependency, and no-go judgments, defect records, statuses, gates, audit records, and model-realization maps. Every component is finite, admissibility is checked on finite records, and every claim is recorded under an explicit host or instrument together with a nonclaim register. The main theorem groups are: no total six-symbol algebra; typed non-collapse and status-family separation; finite well-formedness and covered-cell status uniqueness; descent, closure-deficit, completion, saturation, strict-extension, and definability results; graph and cohomology no-drive results; promotion-gate soundness; and no-overreading and finite rotating-audit theorems. The numbered stack comprises theorem-grade Theorems 1–28 and 30–32, model-grade Model Theorems 29, 33, and 34, and audit-grade Proposition 35. The repository includes a Lean 4 validation track, pinned to leanprover/lean4:v4.28.0, whose manifest-driven strict validator audits the paper-to-Lean declaration coverage. The mathematical content of these theorems is standard — descent through a finite quotient, idempotent saturation, the Kullback–Leibler decomposition, finite cycle/cochain duality, the universal property of the image factorization, and so on — and is not claimed as novel; what the paper contributes is the calculus, its scope discipline, the countermodel atlas, and the explicit nonclaim register within which these results are restated and used. Twelve countermodels CM_1 – CM_ 12 each block a specific overclaim, and four scoped model-realization statements cover finite stochastic PICA, audited Cantor shells, finite abstract-interpretation hosts, and finite graph and cohomology supports. Each model realization is host-bound, fragment-scoped, and certified at claim-strength model_realization rather than theorem-grade accepted. The paper does not prove a universal exact-six theorem, a universal six-symbol algebra, a unique decomposition theorem, an empirical realization claim, or complete same-level self-certification.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: This appendix collects the formal definitions and theorem statements used in the main text. At the level of general mathematical form, the quotient and factorization language used here sits near behavioral equivalence, bisimulation, exact aggregation, and standard quotient-factorization arguments . It does not reproduce proofs. The comparison base is inherited from the first three papers of the series: fixed support and admissibility, the current and predictive quotients on single histories, and the branchwise and recombination quotients on branch assemblages. The present paper uses those inherited structures only to define and compare the flagship recombination family on a common exact-finite support. At the single-history level, the current quotient Q_i identifies reachable histories that are indistinguishable by the current event package, while the predictive quotient M_i identifies histories that remain indistinguishable under all admissible future generator/observable words on the reachable image. At the branch-assemblage level, the branchwise quotient K_i identifies assemblages with the same weighted multiset of predictive classes, while the recombination quotient R_i identifies assemblages that are indistinguishable by admissible later recombination observables. When recombination equivalence refines branchwise equivalence there is a canonical forgetful map _i : R_i → K_i .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The final gate is an ordered case analysis over the upstream audits from . The principal positive case is reached when the native H6 strict domain closes, the strict test families on the new-layer carrier survive controls, and descent preserves old-layer compatibility without turning H2 into a strict-realized layer. Three weaker positive cases are reserved for incomplete new-layer evidence: a threshold-only case in which the new-layer readout slot is strict-realized but test-family reassembly is unavailable; a real-provisional case in which the route preserves or improves support without a completed threshold-and-slot gate; and a below-threshold or pending case. The same case analysis contains five blocking cases and two terminal negative cases. A blocker case obtains if promotion supplies no surviving object, if promotion survives but carrier exactification does not, if exactified threshold evidence cannot descend compatibly to the old layer, if source-policy admission blocks the source use, or if public-shadow safety blocks the route. A falsification case is legal only when neither old-layer nor new-layer threshold, readout, real-provisional, or below-threshold evidence remains. A separate implementation-failure case is reserved for malformed or unavailable artifacts, not for mathematical absence.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Earlier fixed-support papers in Six Birds Theory introduced admissible event packages, predictive quotients, and recombination witnesses. They left open whether a recombination-positive witness family supports a genuine promoted package or only a lower-layer summary. We answer that question on a frozen Route A corpus. We define a promotion criterion requiring sufficiency on the designated observable surface, induced update closure, admissible second-stage stability, control admissibility, protocol honesty, and slice legibility. The corpus is exact-finite and controlled: a two-anchor flagship core, four nearby positives, and matched null, memory-only, artifact, and boundary-sensitive controls, together with a support-only erasure comparison surface. We replace an earlier vacuous second-stage rule with an admissible surface-coarsening audit and treat the artifact control in paired protocol-aware form. On this pipeline, an intrinsic candidate package survives on both flagship anchors, covers the four nearby positives, preserves the required control contrasts, and remains honest under the paired artifact audit. Two representative-selected route families also survive on the flagship core, but only as secondary evidence: they do not support a unique best strategy and they do not displace the intrinsic survivor. Slice/dual analyses are support-only and the staging–packaging defect atlas is explanatory. A Lean criterion kernel formalizes the promotion vocabulary and the generic implication from the criterion fields to promoted-package status. The resulting claim is narrow: at least one promoted-package candidate survives honestly on fixed support in the Route A flagship family.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: This paper isolates a control-stable intrinsic family inside the fixed-support recombination layer of Six Birds theory. The first three papers of the series established admissible event packages on fixed support, predictive quotients on single histories, and the branchwise and recombination quotients on branch assemblages. Here we identify a two-anchor relative-cycle family in which branchwise predictive agreement does not determine later recombination observables. We instantiate the standard factorized no-interference collapse on the flagship surface, exhibit exact-finite separation for two flagship anchors, and formalize a concrete Lean witness kernel for the reference-positive anchor, including a no-factorization corollary. We separate the flagship positives from classical mixture, hidden predictive memory, protocol artifact, and boundary-collapse or completion-sensitive negatives using an explicit matched control bundle. We also show that nearby exact positives exist within the same relative-cycle family, while the erasure side remains empirical support rather than formal core.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The preceding carrier-exactification paper established a scoped carrier layer on the Route A flagship support: a lawful same-branch witness, a non-faithful public signature shadow, a protocol-indexed carrier surface, scoped quadratic carrying, and two proto-event and proto-test pilots. We ask whether this carrier structure supports admissible event and test structure on fixed support. The central construct is an event bridge record B_E=(C,P,I,L,V, ,S,A) binding a carrier-side predicate, a public/readout-side predicate, an instrument, a selected lift or forgetting map, a visibility and suppression record, a threshold record, an exact-six role profile, and an audit record. A deterministic artifact pipeline generates candidate events, constructs bridge records, applies an admissibility gate, runs controls, scores layer placement, attempts finite test-family construction, and records the consequences for shared-event identity, proto-effect structure, quadratic alignment, and exact-six bookkeeping. From a pool of seventeen candidates, two inherited scoped positives — a quadratic level-set event and a transition-stability test — are accepted at the event gate and retained under controls as protocol-indexed event-level objects. No finite admissible test family is accepted: the one serious protocol-indexed bridge-family candidate is non-exhaustive because a required readout-agreement slot is unrealized. The scoped quadratic families organize the accepted q-levelset event boundary at event level but not at test level. The resulting classification is accepted scoped protocol-indexed event-level structure without accepted tests, shared-event identity, or proto-effect operations.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Across disciplines, stable descriptive layers rely on small sets of variables that budget feasibility, accumulate along protocols, or appear as exchange rates between incompatible objectives. We call such variables currencies. This paper gives a layer-relative definition of currency within the Six Birds closure calculus and proposes a currency–constraint principle: lower-layer currencies become higher-layer constraints because packaged higher-level objects can persist only under bounded lower-layer spending, while higher-layer currencies emerge as the shadow prices of those budgets. In finite Markov laboratories this principle becomes measurable. Path-reversal asymmetry and cycle affinities furnish lower-layer audits; constrained maximum-entropy closure yields dual prices; and across a resolution ladder we observe five robust signatures: honest coarse-grained directionality, monotone price emergence with a slack regime, growth of currency dimension with resolution, failure of proxy currencies under prediction and dual stability, and improved packaging coherence under stronger budget enforcement. A Lean formalization proves deterministic-pushforward monotonicity for a finite KL form, providing a formal anchor for the audit side of the story. The result is a practical and conceptual account of why temperatures, prices, regularizers, and attention weights recur across sciences as the same mathematical kind of object.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The paper establishes a substrate-level result. On a fixed-support Six Birds architecture, branchwise predictive structure and recombination-sensitive structure can be separated operationally, and that separation can be audited under exact finite controls. The formal contribution is narrower. The Lean development proves an abstract refinement layer under detectability, a factorized no-interference regime in which the recombination quotient collapses to the branchwise quotient, and the corresponding obstruction result that strict refinement rules out global branchwise factorization. resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The intrinsic route P_ int is the main result because it survives on both flagship anchors, covers the four nearby positives, separates the required controls, and remains honest under the paired artifact audit without requiring representative-selected correction. The representative-selected routes refine that picture rather than replacing it. They show that the surviving-package surface on the flagship core is richer than a single route, but their support remains route-family-level: they do not justify a unique best strategy claim, and they do not displace the intrinsic route. If P_ int had failed and only a representative-selected route had survived, the natural reading would have shifted toward a lift-selected or protocol-indexed package. That is not the current evidential state. Interpreted modestly, this intrinsic-versus-representative asymmetry is closer to familiar contrasts between intrinsic state abstraction, predictive state, and selected refinement than to a claim that one universal abstraction recipe has been proved . The support layers are easier to interpret when kept in their proper place. The slice/dual analysis shows that the surviving-route picture is not exhausted by a single scalar tradeoff ordering: different slices can favor different material route families. This is informative but remains support-only and provisional. The staging–packaging defect atlas contributes explanatory route geometry; it is not a classifier and not even positively ordered in the simplest positive-versus-control way. It sharpens interpretation without entering the claim-bearing pipeline.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Accounting-style inequalities are central in Six Birds Theory, but they do not by themselves rule out catastrophic extremes: highly localized ``needle'' probes can satisfy global budgets while producing large peaks. We ask when packaging plus accounting forces anti-localization, and propose Reflexive SBT: a capacity-based audit of the packaged artifacts (subspaces, feasibility dictionaries, and route ladders). We define a localization metric _j at cell scale 2^ -j , compute it via an eigenvalue method, and upper-bound it using three auditable capacities: subspace trace/diagonal dispersion, sparse feasibility conditioning on small supports, and a route-union ledger charging multi-route inflation. We find three controlled separations: (i) shift-invariant channels (Fourier/circulant) have uniform projector diagonals and _j follows the deterministic m/2^j bound, while diagonal disorder drives _j rapidly toward 1 compared with full-noise perturbations; (ii) feasibility-level needles arise exactly when small-support conditioning collapses ( sigma_ → 0 ) and are absent in random baselines; (iii) for spectral packaging, route mismatch spikes only at degenerate cutoffs and is eliminated by a canonical tie-break, with remaining route effects captured by the union ledger. This turns the anti-localization hinge into a reproducible checklist and yields a conditional theorem: vanishing capacity implies _j→ 0 along a ladder. We are explicit that Reflexive SBT is not proven here to universally drive capacities to zero; we prove the capacity implies anti-localization implications and provide auditable closure evidence on canonical failure and repair modes.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Previous demonstrations of contextuality-type obstruction start from quantum mechanics or from externally specified measurement scenarios. We show that the same locally-Boolean-but-globally-obstructed structure can arise from an autonomous emergence framework—Six Birds Theory—without importing Hilbert space, amplitudes, or the Born rule. The formal vehicle is a finite event package: a family of stable-record contexts, each carrying a finite Boolean event algebra, together with a layer-relative shared-event identification and an audit layer. Obstruction is the failure of admissible global realization for that package. The computational framework combines exact and quotient-backed feasibility, structural and statistical deficits, provenance auditing, and false-positive controls. The evidence base includes a classical control, a boundary-case epistemic calibration, an explicit finite parity/context witness, and autonomous discovery organized by mechanism, lens, and packaging axes. The results are stratified: mechanism variation yields package-sensitive structure with a quotient-backed witness under a weaker claim ceiling; lens variation closes with a cross-resolution strict extension obstruction on fixed support; and packaging variation produces the strongest current obstruction, subject to a package conflict caveat. Where applicable, the principal cases persist under bounded robustness checks. The paper therefore provides the first computationally explicit evidence that contextuality-type obstruction can emerge from a system's own packaging structure rather than from quantum theory or an externally imposed scenario.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Six Birds theory studies finite systems observed through deterministic coarse-grainings (``lenses'') using a small audited vocabulary of primitives. This paper proves eight no-go theorems that constrain when common emergence narratives can be made honest in a finite, checkable setting. For a finite Markov system and horizon T , define an arrow audit as the Kullback–Leibler divergence between the observed path law and its time reversal. We prove a deterministic data-processing inequality: observation cannot increase arrow. As a consequence, any reversible system started in stationarity has zero observed arrow, even when the observation supports nontrivial protocol structure. Further results give graph-theoretic obstructions for force-like antisymmetric drives (exactness on forests and zero cycle sums), a finite variational identity for best macro-kernels and closure deficit, and a bounded-interface saturation theorem that prevents unbounded laddering. Together these theorems delimit what can and cannot be certified as emergent from audited primitives in finite models.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: When must an operator-valued obstruction associated with an involutive system vanish? This paper answers that question inside the Six Birds framework by naming Self-Dual Trace Confinement (SDTC) as the recognition source for formed closures with genuine involutive self-duality. The mechanism is the duality-confinement membrane theorem: for an involutive object ledger with separating anti-invariant readout, a sequence of positive domination records B_n with B_n 0 forces the anti-invariant ledger to vanish and confines visible mass to the fixed locus of the duality. The supporting apparatus develops the involutive object ledger, the anti-invariant ledger and trace identity, direct qualitative and quantitative confinement, completed-domination bridges, Douglas factorization in typed-cone form, exhaustive moving ledgers, and optimized scalar trace budgets. Operator-theoretic realization over trace-class operators is an open extension, as is a derivation of the AM–GM step inside a typed real-arithmetic structure. The development is formalized in Lean as a mathlib-free mechanization at the typed positive-cone level (Appendix ). Cross-substrate generalizations such as CPT symmetry, gauge invariance, quantum self-adjointness, and function-field RH are presented as structural predictions, not theorems; the paper develops the abstract apparatus layer and names the hypotheses any substrate-specific application must supply.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Randomness is often treated as either ontic indeterminacy or epistemic ignorance. We develop a third, operational account within Six Birds: layer-relative randomness is the predictive residue of non-closure under a chosen packaging and budget. For a micro process X_t and a packaging : X Y , we define the micro-closure deficit at scale by CD_ ( )=I(X_t; Y_ t+ Y_t) , the information about the next packaged state that remains hidden inside the current macro-object. This yields the exact decomposition H(Y_ t+ Y_t)=H(Y_ t+ X_t)+CD_ ( ) , separating intrinsic substrate uncertainty from randomness introduced by discarded distinctions. We connect this exact quantity to computable diagnostics native to earlier Six Birds work, including route mismatch for coarse-grained Markov dynamics and predictive log-loss gaps under limited-memory models. In controlled Markov benchmarks, closure deficit vanishes on exactly lumpable partitions and rises with within-fiber heterogeneity, while route mismatch tracks it closely. In budgeted prediction, increasing memory order buys back hidden distinctions and lowers held-out log loss. In toy hashing, one-wayness and random-lookingness emerge as the same packaging-and-budget phenomenon: high-entropy inputs obey q/2^n inversion scaling, while low-entropy inputs collapse the effect. The result is a measurable account of randomness that unifies coarse-graining, limited prediction, and feasible one-wayness without treating randomness as primitive.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The Six Birds corpus through certifies states: each of its laws fixes a single map, quotient, package, or declared finite family and proves a static classification about it. Nothing in the corpus certifies runs — liveness (every orbit eventually earns a certificate), amortized or transfinite cost over unbounded time, covers that must move with their targets, obstructions that grow, react, or are manufactured by the system's own history, route defects that integrate into potentials, transport that emerges from substrate dynamics, or content that persists through repeated loss. This paper is the catalog of exactly those laws: dynamical structural laws (G1–G13), organized in clusters, each stated in the six-part normal form inherited verbatim from and each carrying a temporal quantifier that no static row possesses. The laws were mined from eccentric mathematical problems — Collatz, Goodstein, Egyptian fractions, reverse-and-add, Recam\'an, the angel problem, sandpiles, rule 184, Ducci, aperiodic tilings, Hadwiger–Nelson, Apollonian packings — treated as theorem detectors: each problem's folklore almost-proof names a promoted object, the object's lawful descended certificate fixes a boundary expression, and the residual surviving comparison against every existing law is the law seed. All thirteen laws are mechanized in Mathlib-free Lean 4 with per-declaration kernel-axiom audits; six laws are full theorem-grade rows and one splits into an unconditional theorem and a schema, four are schema-grade with named boxed hypotheses, and three are calibration-anchored schemas discharged end-to-end by solved classical instances. The paper solves no open problem and claims none: Collatz, Erd o s–Straus, Lychrel, Recam\'an, the Langton's-ant highway, Gilbreath, and the exact chromatic number of the plane all remain open, and each law's nonclaims say so explicitly.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The paper establishes a substrate-level result. On a fixed-support Six Birds architecture, branchwise predictive structure and recombination-sensitive structure can be separated operationally, and that separation can be audited under exact finite controls. The benchmark suite shows that the same substrate supports a classical-mixture null regime, hidden predictive memory without additional recombination sensitivity, readable-route suppression, erased conditional recovery, bounded cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. The formal contribution is narrower. The Lean development proves an abstract refinement layer under detectability, a factorized no-interference regime in which the recombination quotient collapses to the branchwise quotient, and the corresponding obstruction result that strict refinement rules out global branchwise factorization. It also proves one theorem-backed concrete positive instance for an aligned Lean model of the promoted family n5_d1_w1of4_3of4 . These results support the interpretation of the benchmark suite but do not replace it.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The intrinsic route P_ int is the main result because it survives on both flagship anchors, covers the four nearby positives, separates the required controls, and remains honest under the paired artifact audit without requiring representative-selected correction. The representative-selected routes refine that picture rather than replacing it. They show that the surviving-package surface on the flagship core is richer than a single route, but their support remains route-family-level: they do not justify a unique best strategy claim, and they do not displace the intrinsic route. If P_ int had failed and only a representative-selected route had survived, the natural reading would have shifted toward a lift-selected or protocol-indexed package. That is not the current evidential state. Interpreted modestly, this intrinsic-versus-representative asymmetry is closer to familiar contrasts between intrinsic state abstraction, predictive state, and selected refinement than to a claim that one universal abstraction recipe has been proved . The support layers are easier to interpret when kept in their proper place. The slice/dual analysis shows that the surviving-route picture is not exhausted by a single scalar tradeoff ordering: different slices can favor different material route families. This is informative but remains support-only and provisional. The staging–packaging defect atlas contributes explanatory route geometry; it is not a classifier and not even positively ordered in the simplest positive-versus-control way. It sharpens interpretation without entering the claim-bearing pipeline.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The accepted strict-test families are partitions of the closed three-slot domain at each carrier. Building a proto-effect fragment would require identifying effect-shaped structure in those families that survives the foundations claim discipline; building an effect algebra would require composition-respecting operations on such effects across the three carriers; a Born valuation would require a state-functional pairing whose values respect the effect-algebra structure; and composition readiness would require the algebraic and state-side constructions to combine coherently. Each step is a separate structural construction beyond the strict-test acceptance reported in Paper 9. Under , absence of those constructions is a nonclaim boundary, not an implied consequence of the accepted tests. The blockers are constructive rather than refutative.
